samples.hyp: Okwekebejja obuwanga obuwetaagibwa obw’okugezesa abantu bonna akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2 okusobola okutangira okusaasaana kwako mu kibuga kikulu Lusaka mu Zambia nga tewabuliddwaako abantu abatali na bulwadde:
Okunoonyereza okulwangu okukozesa eby’obuwandiisi bw’amaloboozi.

Obulwadde obw’akawuka aka Coronavirus (COVID-19), obuvudde mu kawuka aka severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus—2 (SARS-CoV-2), mu Afirika bulagiddwa okuba n’abantu bangi abatalina bimanyiro (oba abalina obulwadde obutono) abalowoozebwa okuba n’omukono mu mpappawo y’obulwadde buno.
Obutundu obutuufu n’obukadde bw’abantu abatalina bulwadde obulabika obw’okusaasanya obulwadde tebunnaba kutegeerekeka bulungi.
Kyokka, okunoonyereza kulaga nti okuddukanya kwabwe kyetaagisa nnyo okutangira okusasaana kw’akawoono ka SARS-CoV-2.

Twalonzeemu modero ya mathematiki esookererezzawo ey’ekika kya SEIR (susceptible-exposed-infectious-removed) okwekenneenya omulimu gw’okweggyawo abantu abalina akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2 naye nga tebalina bulwadde okuyitira mu kukebera abantu bonna mu kulwanyisa obulwadde mu ssaza ly’e Lusaka mu Zambia.

Wano twakolawo ebifaananyi bibiri; (1) nga tulowooza nti abantu abatalina bulwadde baali 70% ku bantu bonna abaalina COVID-19 era (2) nga abantu abatalina bulwadde baali 50% ku bantu bonna abaalina obulwadde.

Okugeraageranya, ekyokulabirako kyapimibwa olubereberye nga kigendererwa nti abantu abatalina bulwadde booleka bulwadde mu ngeri y’emu ng’abalina bulwadde, oluvannyuma ne lwa kubiri, era nga kye kiyinza okuba, nga kigendererwa nti abantu abatalina bulwadde booleka bulwadde mu kigero kya kabiri ku kya abalina bulwadde.

Mu ngeri y’omukisa eyakiraga nti abalwadde abataalina bimujjo baali 70%, okwekebejja kwa bulijjo okw’enjawulo okusingawo 7911 okwekebejja/abantu 100000 kwakwata okuyamba okutangira obulwadde bwe kiba nti abantu abataalina bimujjo balina obuwuka obutono emirundi ebiri, naye bwe kiba nti obuwuka bwa balwadde abataalina bimujjo buli bumu, okwekebejja kwa bulijjo okusingawo 10028 okwekebejja/abantu 100000 kyali kye kyali kyetaagisa.

Okusobola okutaataaganya obulwadde obw’ekirwadde ekitakyoleka, okupima abantu bonna okusingawo okutuuka ku ≥ 4540 obugero/abantu 100000 kwakwana okukakasa obutaatera kw’ekirwadde ku mitindo gyonna egyaakirabwa egy’obutabalwa bw’abantu abatalina bulwadde mu mubiri bw’okuyamba abantu abalina bulwadde.
Okuteesa n’okuggula.

Munnamuze waffe alaga nti okweggyako abalwadde ba COVID-19 abalina obulwadde n’abatabulina, nga tuyita mu kukebera abantu bonna, kiyinza okukozesebwa ng’engeri emu ey’okutangira okusasaana kwa akawuka ka SARS-Cov-2 mu Lusaka, Zambia, naye kyandibadde kya bintu bingi.
Okwekebejja abantu bangi mu bibuga ebinene gamba nga Lusaka kiyinza okukendeeza okusasaana kwa COVID-19, naye kiba kikyamu?
Mu 2020, ebyokubala bya kompyuta byalagula nti okusaasaana kwa COVID-19 mu bibuga ebinene kyanditwalibwa bulungi okuyitira mu kukebera abantu bangi, n’okubawulawo bonna abaali balina akawuka.
Kyokka, abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola eno eyinza okuba ya muwendo nnyo era nga teyagasa.
Mu ntandikwa y’ekirwadde kya COVID-19, abantu bangi abaali bakwatibwa tebaalaga bimanyiro byonna byakyo naye ne batwalayo ekirwadde eri abalala.
Okunoonyereza okumu kulaga nti abantu abali wakati wa 50% ne 80% abalina COVID-19 tebaalabikaako bulimu (abatulina bulimu), era bayinza okuba nga be baaleetayo obuwuka obupya wakati wa 40% ne 70%.
Abanoonyereza baali baagala okumanya oba okunoonyereza n’okwawula abantu abatalina bulwadde kyandisobodde okuyamba okutangira COVID-19 okusaasaana.
Baali baagala okumanya era oba okwekebejja abantu bangi mu bujjuvu (banket-testing), kitegeeza okwekebejja abantu bangi mu bujjuvu, kiba kikyamu okuzuula abantu abatalina bulwadde.
Abanoonyereza baakola mudolu ya kompyuta eteegeka engeri abantu gye bayita okuva mu kuba abalina omuwendo gw’okufuna obulwadde okutuuka ku kuba abalwadde, abalwadde, n’abawerekeddwa.
Baateeka essira ku byawandiikibwa okuva mu disitulikiti ya Lusaka mu Zambia, ekika kya kkampuni enkulu erimu oluguudo lw’ennyonyi olw’ensi yonna era erisangibwa ku nsalo y’ensi ebiri.

Olw’okuba enkyukakyuka za COVID-19 zaalabikanga nga ziva awamu okuva ekifo eri ekifo, baatunula mu mbeera 4, nga mu mbeera zino, oba 50% oba 70% by’abalina COVID-19 tebalina bulwadde, era abantu bano baali balina obulwadde obw’amaanyi oba obutono okukira abalina obulwadde.

Ebyoonoonyereza by’abakugu byalaga nti kyali kisoboka okufuga okusasaana kw’akawoonoono ka COVID-19 nga bakola kugezesa abantu bonna era nga bawalirawo abantu bonna abaafunye akawuka, ne bo abataalina bulwadde.
Baagamba nti okukendeeza omuwendo gw’abantu abalwadde ku ntikko ku bitundu 90% mu mbeera zonna, kyali kyetaagisa okwekebejja abantu 10% aba Lusaka buli lunaku.
Baazzuula era nti singa twagala omuwendo gw’abantu abafuna COVID-19 okweyongera okusigala nga gumu, abantu 22% baalina okwekebejjebwa buli lunaku.
Wadde Zambia yateekawo ebiragiro bingi eby’okutangira COVID-19, obukadde bwaabwo bwakweyongera.
Okwekebejja abantu bonna mu kibuga kitono eky’omu Buyitale kyagumya omuwendo gw’abantu abalwadde COVID-19 nga 90%.
Naye, tewali kunoonyereza kwakolebwa emabega okulanga nti kyandiba kya mugaso mu kibuga kinene ekirala.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza tebaakoze kugeza ku bantu bonna; wabula baakola mukwano ogwoleka nti okwekebeza abantu bonna kwandibadde kukozesebwa okutangira akawuka ka COVID-19 okusaasaana mu bibuga ebinene.
Kyokka, baalabula nti kyali kigenda kuba kya bbeeyi nnyingi.
Baagamba nti era kiyinza okuba kya mulembe okusinga singa kikozesebwa awamu n’enkola endala, gamba ng’okusiba ebifo, okugezaako abantu abakwatiddwa, n’okutema eggwanga.
Ate era, abanoonyereza okuva mu Zambia baategeeza nti abalwadde ba COVID-19 abatalina bimujjo baalabikira okuba bangi mu Afirika mu kiseera ekyo.
Obutono bw’okuyinza okukozesa amasoboza g’obuwangwa mu bantu ba Afrika olw’enjawulo y’obuwangwa n’obuwangwa bw’obutonde.
Abantu ba Afrika tebali ba waggulu mu kunoonyereza ku ndagabutonde, naye balina enjawulo ya ndagabutonde ennyingi era balina embeera ez’obutonde ez’enjawulo mu nsi yonna.

Olw’okuba okwekebejja okutongolebwa obulungi okw’okwolesa eby’obuwangwa tekyali kukolebwa mu bantu ab’enjawulo eza Afrika, twabala obuwuka obw’obulamu (PRS) mu kugezesa okw’okuwangaala mu Afrika era ne mu byawandiikibwa eby’amazima okuva e South Africa, Uganda, ne UK okutegeera obulungi engeri okugezesa okw’obuwangwa gye kuyinza okukolerwa mu bantu ab’enjawulo.
Obuwanguzi bwa PRS bweyongera nga bakozesa abantu abafanana mu bika mu kunoonyereza okusinga okukozesa abantu abatafaanagana mu bika.
Mu bantu ba South Africa abava mu bika n’ebika by’abantu eby’enjawulo, tusanga nti obugenderevu bw’omugero gwa PRS buwanvu ku bintu byonna, naye bw’ekyukakyuka mu bika.

Enjawulo mu mazannyo g’abantu ba Afrika zikulembeza okuleetera enjawulo mu bukozese obw’omutindo gwa PRS okusinga enjawulo endala ez’ebika ebinene ebyalabikidwa wakati w’abantu mu Bungereza ne Uganda.

Twabala PRS mu bantu ab’oluganda lw’Africa nga tukozesa okunoonyereza okwabadde ku bantu b’omu Bulaaya bokka okutwalagana n’okunoonyereza okw’oluganda lw’ebika eby’enjawulo; okweyongera kw’enjawulo kwaleeta ekyongeza ekinene mu bukozeseebwa bw’okubala kwa hemoglobin ne muwendo gw’abantu ab’omubiri omweru, nga kikwata ku nkyukakyuka enkulu ez’oluganda lw’ebika ez’omuwendo omukulu mu jini ezimanyiika okukwata ku siriki seeri anemia n’okulwaza okw’ekika kya allergic, okusinziira ku bintu ebyo.
Enjawulo mu bukozeseza bw’omugaso gwa PRS mu bantu abava mu bitundu bya Afrika eby’enjawulo, zikulu nga za bantu abava ebweru kwa Afrika, era ekyo kyetaagisa okutegeera obulungi.
Lwaki tetusobola kutegeera bulungi obulwadde obw’obulamu mu bantu abava mu Afrika
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola ezikozesebwa kati okuteesa oba omuntu ajja kuwona obulwadde obw’obuwangwa oba nedda tezikolera bulungi bantu abava mu Afrika.
Kino kuba nti edatabaasi eriko ebintu ebyo ebyogerwako ebirala eby’obuwangwa bw’abantu ab’omu Bulaaya.
Datenbeesi ya GWAS kitegeeza “Genome-Wide Association Studies”, era abayizi b’obuwangwa babikozesa okunoonya ebintu n’endwadde okusinziira ku jinomu.
Mu butuufu, basobola okukozesa GWAS okubala obungi bw’obulamu obw’omuntu obuva mu bwavu obw’obutabanguko oba obulamu.
Kyokka, ebisinga obungi bw’ebitundu by’obuwangwa mu GWAS bijja mu bantu abava mu Bulaaya.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baali baagala okulaba obulungi bw’okubala kwe bakozesa okutegeera obungi bw’obuzibu bw’obulamu obw’obuwangwa nga bakozesa GWAS ku bantu abava mu Afrika.

Baagala era okwetegereza oba okukozesa GWAS ey’engeri ez’enjawulo, mu kwogera okw’enjawulo, nga data base erimu ebintu ebingi eby’obuwangwa bw’Abafrika, kyandibadde kyeyongera okukola obulungi mu kwesimbawo.
Okubala kuno kweyambisibwa mu sayansi nga “polygenic risk score”, oba PRS.

Baakozesa kompyuta okubala obulabe obw’obuwangwa obw’abantu ba Afrika obuteeseeteseebwa nga bakozesa GWAS, era baakozesa ebiwandiiko by’eby’obulamu by’abantu ba Afrika okwetegereza ebintu oba endwadde ezimu eziyinza okuba zivudde ku nkyukakyuka mu buwangwa.
Bwe baakozesa European GWAS, baazuula nti obukulu bw’obulamu obw’obuwangwa bwali butuufu nnyo singa abantu balina omuntu ow’e Bulaaya okusinga abantu ab’e Afrika ku bintu bingi.
Baagamba nti obuwuka bw’obulabe buwanvu nnyo wakati w’ebitundu bya Afrika olw’obuwanvu obusingawo mu bantu, ekyo tekyogerera ku ebyo bye tulabye mu bantu abava mu Bulaaya.
Era baagamba nti obugwanika bwa PRS bweyongera nga obuwangwa bw’abantu ba Afrika bwe bugenda buseera.
Abantu ba Ethiopia baafunye obusembayo obulungi mu kwesambazanga obulwadde olw’obuwangwa bwabwe obufaanana n’obw’abantu ba Bulaaya.
Bwe twakozesa GWAS ey’enjawulo eya kizingiramu abantu abava mu Afrika, obugenderevu bw’okubikkula byongedde.
Okubagula obulwadde bw’omusaayi kyali kigwanvu nnyo.

Okunoonyereza okw’emabega kulaze nti PRS ya wansi mu bantu b’omu Afrika, ekitegeeza nti ekitabo ekikulu eky’okunoonyereza ku ndagabutonde (GWAS) kiragira obungi obutono bw’obulabe bw’endwadde ezava mu ndagabutonde eri abantu abava mu Afrika.
Naye tukimanyi nti kino tekyali kituufu.

Okunoonyereza kuno kulaga nti obuwuka obutono obw’obuzibu bw’obulamu obuva mu njigina kuba genne za Afrika teziyimiriddwa bulungi mu kibanja kya GWAS, era olwo obuwuka bwa PRS obwo obuliwo kati tebuyamba nnyo mu kwesimba obuzibu bw’obulamu obuva mu njigina mu Afrika.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti kyandibadde kirungi okukozesa ettaka ly’ebitabo eby’enjawulo ekirimu ebintu by’obulamu okuva mu bantu abava mu Afrika.
Kyeyava kibeetaagisa okukola omulimu ogw’okwongera okutaano kwa GWAS okugezaako n’abantu ab’e Bulaaya, tusobole okutegeeza obulwadde obw’obuwangwa mu bantu b’e Bulaaya mu ngeri esinga obutuufu.
Abawandiisi b’okunoonyereza kuno baali abava mu Afrika, Amerika, ne Bungereza.
Okwekebejja okw’amaaso n’okwekebejja kw’ebitundu eby’omu mubiri mu kuziyiza ekintu ekya Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia ne kansala ya lubuto mu Namibia.
Abakyala abasukka mu 851,340 mu Namibia bali mu kabi ak’okufuna akawuka ka human papillomavirus (HPV) akasobola okuleeta kookolo w’ekisinde.
Okwekebejja olugero ng’okozesa asitiki asiidi (VIA) n’okukulukuta kuziyiza okulwala kuliko obuwanguzi bungi.
Kyokka, tewali data ekolagana n’obuvunyi bw’enteekateeka z’okwekebejja kansa y’ekibumba.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwakola ku kubuzaabuza kw’amaaso n’okwekebejja kwa buliwo okuziyiza obulwadde bwa CIN (cervical intraepithelial lesions) ne kansala y’ekibumba ky’omuntu mu Namibia.

Ebyazuulibwa byalaga nti abakyala abalina akawuka ka HPV, cervicitis, koilocytosis, n’enkyukakyuka ezitali za bulijjo mu bulimu bw’ekitundu ky’ekibumba ekya bulimu (atypia) balimu enkizo ey’okubaawo obusembayo obw’obuwanguzi mu kukebera kwa VIA.
Abakyala abakulu, naddala abalina akawuka ka HIV, be basinga okufuna ekikomo kya squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).

Enkola ya VIA ebonera okubeera ey’omugaso mu kukebera, wadde nti okukozesa colposcopy mu kugoberera abalwadde mu buwangwa bwa Namibia kyetaagisa okuddamu okulabirirwa era ne kukolebwa ng’ebisobozesa bya HR-HPV biriwo.

Okusalawo enkola ez’okwekebejja nga mulimu okukebejja akawuka ka HPV ku bantu ab’emyaka egy’enjawulo n’abo abalina obulabe (e.g. abalina akawuka ka HIV, obulwadde obwonoona obugendereza bw’omubiri) kye kiragibwa.

Okweyongera okukozesa okukebera kuyinza okweyongera okutumbula nga tuyita mu nkola ezikozesa enkola etuukiriza ebyava mu kukebera okwasooka, ebiruubirirwa by’obulamu bw’abakyala, amagezi ag’omukutu n’omukolo ogukwata ku mbeera y’eggwanga.
Abakyala ba Namibia abalina obulabe bw’okufuna kansa y’ekitundu ky’omubiri ekibaddemu omwana (cervical cancer) balina okwekebejjebwa era okukolwaako mangu.
Ebigezo bingi bisobola okulaga omusango gw’omukyala okufuna kansa ya lubuto, naye okukebera okubaawo buli kiseera mu Namibia tebikozesezza bulijjo bigezo bino.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti okwekebejja buli kiseera, okusobola okuzuula obubonero obulengejja mu butereevu, kiyinza okuziyiza abakyala obutaba n’ekirwadde kino ekibaawo.
Kansa ya nkalongo (kansa ey’ekitundu ekikadde ekya lubuto) ewa abakyala bangi okufa mu nsi yonna.
Ekimu ku bintu ebiyamba okuvaayo kansa ya lukwata lye lwa buli kintu ekisinga obunene kwe kubawo kwa ka virus aka Human Papillomavirus, oba HPV.
HPV ye virusi ewonona obusembo bw’ekibumba, nga eteekawo ebisago ebiyitibwa lesions, ebiyinza okukoma okuba kansa.
Wadde waliwo eddagala ery’okutambuza ekirwadde kya HPV, abakyala bangi mu mawanga ga Afrika, omuli ne Namibia, tebakifuna.
Kino kitegeeza nti okwekebejja akawuka oba obulwadde bwe buleeta kikulu nnyo eri abakyala bano, kubanga y’engeri esingayo obulungi ey’okuyambako okutangira kansa.
Abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno bagamba nti, olwo ebitongole by’eby’obujjanjabi byewetaaga obulagirizi obulungi n’amawulire agakwata ku bikozesebwa ebirungi eby’okugezesa.
Bagattako nti abakozi b’eby’obujjanjabi nabo beetaaga amawulire agagatta ku ngeri ebintu gamba ng’emyaka oba obulamu bw’omukyala bwe bikwata ku kabenje k’omukyala okufuna akawuka ka HPV n’ekansala.
Baanoonyereza engeri embeera ezigemeddwa okukebera (eziyitibwa enkola z’okwekebera) gye zaali mu kuzuula akawuka ka HPV n’ebiwundu.
Baali era baagala okugerageranya enkola z’okukola ku bulimu, ekyokulabirako okugolola obuwuka okuva mu lubuto okwekebejja obulyo obwonooneka nga bageraageranya n’okunoonya ebikomere byokka.

Baali baagala okumanya era obanga enjawulo wakati w’abakyala, gamba nga myaka gyabwe, oba obanga balina endwadde endala gamba nga ekikoko, kyakyukakyuka omukisa gwabwe okufuna akawuka ka HPV n’ekkansaa.
Okumanya ebintu bino kuyamba eddwaliro n’amaka g’obujjanjabi okukozesa enkola z’okwekebejja obulungi.
Abanoonyereza baakola okwekebejja ebiwandiiko by’abantu 214 abaali baweereddwa okukebejja n’okujjanjabwa obulwadde bwa HPV, ebibala, n’ekikansa ky’ekibumba mu ddwaaliro e Windhoek, mu Namibia.
Baateekawo essira naddala ku kookolo w’ekitundu ky’ekibumba ekya buli bw’omukolo eky’oku ntandikwa, kubanga mu kiseera ekyo obulwadde buba busobola okujjanjabwa bulungi era mu buwanguzi.
Baakungula era amawulire agakwata ku myaka gy’omukazi buli omu, n’obulamu bwe obujjuvu.

Bwe baalondoola ebiri ku lupapula, baazuula nti enkola ez’okwekebejja ezaali eza buli ngeri zaali zibawa abakozi b’eby’obujjanjabi amawulire ag’enjawulo, era nga zayinza okuba n’omugaso ennyo nga HPV tennaba kufuuka kansa oba nga yaakafuuka kansa.
Okugeza, kansa yakwatibwanga nnyingi okuyita mu kukunganya n’okwekebejja obusembwa bw’ekibumba.
Kyokka, ebikomere byakyasoboka okulabikira mu kulondoola mpozzi, nga mukozesa enkola eyitibwa “okulondoola mpozzi nga okozesa asitiki asiidi” (VIA).
Ensimbi y’omukolo guno eri mu nsonga ya kuba nti kiyamba abasawo okukizuula obulwadde mangu era nga tebikalu.
Kuba kikozesa ebikozesebwa eby’ebbugumu eby’ekikubo eby’abakyala, gamba ng’ekikozesebwa ekya speculum (ekintu eky’ekyuma ekikozesebwa okulaba munda mu lubuto).
Baazzuula era nti okukozesa enkola ez’enjawulo buli kiseera kyalina okugaba abasawo amagezi mangi ku kabi kya mukazi okufuna kansala, naddala mu bujjanjabi obw’emirembe.

Okwongera, abanoonyereza baazuula nti abakyala abakulu, naddala abo abalina akawuka ka HIV, baali basobola okufuna ekirwadde kya kansala, n’olwekyo okubakebera bulijjo kyandisobodde okuba ekikulu nnyo.
Abanoonyereza baagattako nti bakyala batono nnyo be baakebeddwa ekirwadde kya HPV (nga tebannafuna mawanga) wadde ng’okugeza kuliwo.
Okukola bwetyo kyandisobodde okuba ngeri ya mukulu ey’okuzannya obulwadde mangu n’okusingawo.

Mu ngeri yonna, bagamba nti ebyava mu kunoonyereza kwabwe byalaga nti waliwo obwetaavu bw’okuteekerateekerawo enkola z’okutangira akawuka ka HPV n’ekikansa ky’ekibumba mu Namibia mu ngeri ey’obwegendereza, nga bakozesa enkola z’okwekebejja ez’ovunanyuma era ez’omugugu okusobola okuzuula obulwadde buno mu kiseera ekikadde.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa nga kwegatta wamu kwa ba sayansi okuva e Namibia ne Afrika ebukiikakkono.
Amatendekero agasinga mu kuvuba obulwadde bwa HBV/HIV nga bigabanye n’okuvaayo kw’obulwadde bwa HBV bokka mu kibiina ky’abantu ab’omu South Africa.

Olw’ebigendererwa by’ensi yonna eby’okumalawo akawuka ka Hepatitis B (HBV), twatandika okwekenneenya abantu abalina akawuka ka HBV bokka n’abo abalina akawuka ka HBV ne akawuka ka HIV, okwekenneenya omulimu gw’eddagala n’okulambika enkyukakyuka mu byobulamu.
Tukubuulira ebintu bye twalaba mu kwekaliriza abantu 115 abakulu abalina obulwadde bwa Hepatitis B obutaggwaawo (CHB), mu ddwaaliro lya yunivasite e Cape Town, e South Africa.
Abantu 39 (34%) baalina akawuka ka HIV.
Twakukiŋŋaanya ebifaayo by’abantu, eby’obujjanjabi n’ebya mu laboletori eby’ekiseera kimu.

Abantu abakulu abalina akawuka ka HBV bokka, nga bageraagerannyizibwa n’abo abalina akawuka ka HIV ne ka HBV, baali abato nnyo okuba nga balina HBeAg (p=0.01), abato nnyo okwekebejjebwa n’omukutu gw’okwekebejja (elastography) (p<0.0001), era abato nnyo okuba ku bujjanjabi bw’okulwanyisa akawuka (p<0.0001); baali bangi okuba nga balina akawuka ka HBV mu muwendo gukakasibwa (p=0.04), era baali bangi okuba nga balina obubonero bw’obulwadde bw’ebiwuka eby’omu kibumba omuli thrombocytopaenia eya bukadde/ey’amaanyi (p=0.007), bilirubin ey’ekigero ekigulumivu (p=0.004), ne APRI score ey’ekigero ekigulumivu (p=0.02).
Ebyokubula 3 by’ekirwadde kya kansala y’omubiri (hepatocellular carcinoma) byonna byava mu kawuka ka HBV kwokka.

Ebibala byaffe biraga nti abantu abalina obulwadde bwa HBV bokka bayinza okuba mu mbeera embi okusinga abo abalina obulwadde bwa HIV, nga kino kiraga obutali bwenkanya mu kusindika abantu mu malwaliro, okulaba embeera y’abantu, n’okubawonya.
Abanoonyereza bawa obulagirizi obw’okuyamba okukola obulongoosoka ku bulwadde bwa Hepatitis B.

Mu kunoonyereza kwa gye buvuddeko, abanoonyereza basobodde okwoleka engeri okuva mu mubiri mu bubonero bwa Hepatitis B (HBV) ne akawuka ka HIV bw’okuyamba mu kuwonawo okusinga okuva mu mubiri mu bubonero bwa HBV yokka.
Mu bukiika kkono bwa Afirika, obulwadde obw’obuwuka obwa HBV ne HIV obubeerawo okumala ebbanga eddene buli kizibu kinene.
Abasawo beetaaga okutegeera engeri obuwuka buno n’eddagala ebiwewulwaamu gye bikwatagana, basobole okufuna obulwadde obulungi era bakola obulongoofu ku balwadde.
Abanoonyereza baali baagala okugerageranya engeri obujjanjabi bwe bwakolerera abalwadde abaalina akawuka ka HBV bokka, n’abalwadde abaalina akawuka ka HBV ne ka HIV.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baasonda abalwadde abakulu 115 abalina obulwadde bwa Hepatitis B obutakoma (CHB).
Baasindikibwa okuva mu ddwaaliro e Tygerberg e Cape Town, e South Africa.
Abantu abamu baalwala akawuka ka HIV (39) ate abalala baalwala akawuka ka HBV bokka.
Abanoonyereza baatunuulidde ekika, myaka n’obutonde, era baakola ebigezo by’ekisawo n’ebya laboratoli eby’enjawulo.

Baalaba nti abalwadde abaalina obulwadde bwa HBV bokka baali basusse okuba nga tebakozesezza bujjanjabi bwonna obw’eddagala erirwanyisa akawuka, nga balaga obubonero obwa bulijjo bw’obulwadde bw’ebiwundu by’omubiri (kubanga HBV ye akawuka akasobola okuleeta obulwadde bw’ebiwundu by’omubiri obw’amaanyi).

Abanoonyereza baasobola okulaga nti abantu abalina akawuka ka HBV bokka baali mu buzibu bw’okukira abalina akawuka ka HIV ne HBV, kubanga abalwadde abalina obubaka bw’amawuka gombi baali basobola okufuna eddagala ery’okulwanyisa akawuka ka HIV, eriyamba n’okulwanyisa akawuka ka HBV.

Ebyavudde mu kunoonyereza kuno biraga obukulu bw’enjawulo eriwo wakati w’okujjawo, okugoberera n’okujjanjabwa kw’akaawa ka HBV bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n’akaawa ka HIV ne HBV nga kakolebwa wamu, ekyo kikolera obulungi abo abalina akaawa ka HIV ne HBV bombi.
Abanoonyereza baasomesa nti tulina okutereeza era tuwe abalwadde abalina akawuka ka HBV bokka obuweereza obulungi era obutaliiko kabi.
Omu ku bukyamu bw’okunoonyereza kuno kwe kuba nti omuwendo gw’abantu abaakoleddwaako okunoonyereza gwa wansi era nga gwali gwa ggwanga limu n’amawanga galyo.
Ebitongole by’eby’obujjanjabi ebimu, oboolyawo eby’omuwendo omwangu, biyinza okulaga endowooza eyenjawulo bw’ebigeraageranyizibwa n’ebyaazulibwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Okunoonyereza okw’okwongera kwandibadde kukoleddwa okutegeera obutali bumu obuzuulibwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Ekitabo kino kyalaze amaanyi g’okukolera wamu, nga abanoonyereza abaakola ku nsonga eno bavudde mu South Africa ne mu Bungereza.
Okukozesa abantu abalwadde okuva e South Africa mu kunoonyereza kuno, kikwata ku kitundu ky’abantu ba Afrika.
Okwongera, okunoonyereza kuno kuyinza okuyamba okukola enteekateeka z’okujjanjabwa obulungi eri abo abalwadde oluusi ne HBV, HIV oba zombi.
Okwekebejja Obuzibu Obw’obulabe ku Bikolwa by’Obusuubuzi bw’Abakyala mu Kitundu kya Gavumenti Eky’e SHIRORO mu Disitulikiti ya Niger.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwakeberawo engeri obutali bwa butebenkevu bwe bukwata ku mirimu gy’obusuubuzi gy’abakyala mu kitundu kya Gavumenti y’eka kya Shiroro eky’omu disitulikiti ya Niger, nga kikulembeddewa ku nsonga ez’okutegeka abakyala ku ssente, omukolo gw’emirimu gy’obusuubuzi egya bulijjo gye bakola, n’engeri obutali bwa butebenkevu bwe bukwata ku mirimu gyabwe gy’obusuubuzi.
Mu kubuuzibwa abakyala 377, ebyazuulibwa byalaga nti abakyala ab’e Shiroro balina obugagga obw’omukisa n’obugagga obw’enjawulo, era bakola omulimu ogw’obutunda obutono (SMEs).

Okunoonyereza kuno era kwazuula nti wadde obutakwatagana bulina omuwendo mubi ku mirimu gy’abakyala egy’obusuubuzi mu ngeri y’okubulwa oba okukendeera kw’ensimbi wakati wa bintu ebirala, omuwendo gw’abakyala abasuubuzi teguweddewo okukendeera kwa maanyi.

Okunoonyereza kuno kulagira nti wandibaddewo programu eziyimirirwa okuyamba abakyala okufuna n’okukozesa obuweereza bw’ensimbi, era n’ebitongole eby’okukuuma omutemwa mu bitundu ebyo byandibaddewo era ne bikuumibwa bulungi okwewala obutali bwa butebenkevu mu kitundu ekyo ekyonoonyerezebwa.
Abakyala abakola omulimu mu Niger beetaaga obukuumi obusingawo.
Abanoonyereza baazuula nti abakyala abakola omulimu gw’obusuubuzi mu Niger balina obugagga nnyo era beekuumira ku nsimbi zaabwe, naye obulamu obutaliiko buwuka bwa bannabbi bw’ekizibu.

Abanoonyereza baabadde baagala okumanya obutonde n’obuwanvu bw’abakyala abakolera emirimu mu kitundu kya gavumenti eky’e Shiroro mu Niger State, n’engeri ekyo gye kiyinza okukwata ku mirimu gyabwe n’obugagga bwabwe.
Baabuuliza abakyala 377 mu kitundu kino ebizibu bye baasanga mu mirimu gyabwe egy’obusuubuzi, obutawana mu byensimbi n’obutakkiriza.
Baategeeza nti abakyala 43% baagamba nti tebaŋŋamira ku basajja ku ssente, ate 32% baagamba nti waliwo abalala abaŋŋamira ku bo ku ssente.
Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti abakyala 85% baali bafuna ssente okuva mu mirimu egy’enjawulo, era abatono be baategeeza nti baali beesiga mitala gya buli mwezi.
Abantu abakola ebitundu nga 56% baafuna ensimbi okuva mu kulima, ate abakola ebitundu nga 79% okuva mu bulimi.
Abakyala nga omu ku bataano baali bafuna ssente okuyita mu kukola omulimu gw’okulongooseza enviiri, okussa, okubuuza oba okuwoza.
Abakyala abasinga obungi (91%) baategeeza abanoonyereza nti emirimu gyabwe gyakosebwa olw’okutya okukubwa ababbi n’abamenyi b’amateeka.
Bavaamu ssente ne batwala n’abaami baabwe olw’ebikwekweto ebyo, oluusi ne bibasobozesa okulabirira abaana baabwe bokka.
Abakyala era baagamba nti tebaalina busobozi n’ensimbi za kweyongerazaamu bizinensi zaabwe.
Abanoonyereza baategeeza nti wadde nga waliwo obuzibu obwo, abakyala ba Buganda baali bakyagenda mu maaso bulungi nnyo mu mirimu gyabwe.
Baagamba nti Shiroro yalina abantu b'ebika n'eddiini ez'enjawulo, era n'ekyo kyali kirungi ku by'obusuubuzi.
Okunoonyereza kuno kukakasanya ebyazuulibwa by’abanoonyereza abalala abaategeeza nti abakyala tebafuna buwanguzi mu bulimu olw’okukuuma awaka.
Wabula, abanoonyereza bano bagamba nti obuwanguzi bw’abakyala abakola omulimu mu kitundu kino eky’e Niger bukwatibwa nnyo oluyiggo lw’okulumbibwa abamenyi b’amateeka n’ababi.
Abanoonyereza baawa amagezi nti abantu bonna abalina kye bakwatagana n’obuwangwa obwo balina okukwatagana okulwanyisa ebintu ebiyinza okuleetera obuzibu mu kukulaakulana kw’ebyenfuna.
Okugeza, abakyala mu Niger balina okufuna obuyambi obw’ensimbi, obulimi, n’obutebenkevu obusingawo.
Era baategeeza nti abakyala abakola omulimu basobola okukola amatendeke agabayamba okulwanyisa ababbi n’abamenyi b’amateeka.

Amatendekebwa g’ebintu eby’obuwangwa mu musaayi gw’amaama, okuli Selenium, Copper ne Zinc mu kiseera ky’olubuto, galina akakwate n’obuzibu bw’okufuna embuto nga tekinnaba kufuuka: Okunoonyereza okukozesa abantu abalina obulwadde n’abalimu.  (Okunoonyereza okukoledwa mu Malawi)
Okubaaza omwana nga tannatuuka wiiki 37.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa okwekenneenya enkolagana eri wakati w’obungi bw’ekika kya selenium, copper, ne zinc mu musaayi gw’omaama, n’okuzza omwana nga tannaweza ebbanga ly’omwezi.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno okw’okwekenneenya, waaliwo abakyala 181, 90 ku 181 (49.7%) abaalwala embuto ezikuŋŋaana, ne 91 ku 181 (50.3%) abaalwala embuto ezitaliikuŋŋaana.

Amagulu g’omugaso gw’ekitundu kya selenium mu musaayi gwali 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, ekya copper gwali 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L era ekya zinc gwali 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L nga ebibalo eby’okujaguza biri 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L ne 0.59-1.11 mg/L okusinziira ku nteekateeka.
Ebyavudde mu kunoonyereza biraga nti tewali buzibu bw’obutaaba na selenium ne zinc; era nga waliwo obungi bw’ekika kya copper mu musaayi mu kiseera ky’obugabe.
Okufuna omwana nga tannaweza ebbanga ly’okubeera mu lubuto kwakwatagana n’obungi bw’ekika kya copper ne zinc mu musaayi gwa maama.
Obunene bwa Zinc, copper, ne selenium ebiyambako okuzuula embeera y’okufuna omwana nga tannaweza myezi 9.

Abanoonyereza baazuula obuwunga obw’omugaso obw’enjawulo obw’omuwendo ogw’omukulu, nga selenium, copper, ne zinc, mu bakyala abaalwala okuzaala abaana nga tebannaweza ebbanga ly’okuzzaala, naye tebannamanya oba obuwunga buno buva mu mmere gye balya.
Okufuna omwana nga waliwo ebbanga ly’obukadde (preterm birth) kibawo omukazi bw’aba alyaza omwana nga tannaweza wiiki 37 ez’obukadde.
Okubaawo kw’omwana nga tannaweza ebbanga ly’okubeera mu lubuto kukwatagana n’obulamu obutali bulungi bw’omwana okuva ku bunafu okutuuka ku kufa.
Lwatuuka okuzaala mangu, kiyinza okuba n’enjawulo y’ensonga, naye omulimu gw’obungi bw’emigaso egisangibwa mu mmere n’obutonde bw’ensi, tegumanyiddwa bulungi.
Ebiriisa ebyo ebitono bya muwendo nnyo mu kukula kw’omwana, naye abanoonyereza baagala okumanya ekibawo nga biba bingi ennyo.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baagala okupima obungi bw’ekika ky’obuwunga obw’ekika kya selenium, copper, ne zinc mu bakyala abaafuna embuto ezitali za buli kiseera, oluvannyuma ne bategeere obusobozi bw’okufuna embuto ezitali za buli kiseera olw’obungi bw’ebintu ebyo eby’obuwunga.
Abanoonyereza baakunganya omusaayi okuva mu bakyala 181 oluvannyuma lw’okubaaza mu malwaliro abiri e Lilongwe, olukiiko lw’e Malawi, wakati wa Juuni 2016 ne Maaliki 2017.
Baatwala sampoolo z’omusaayi ku lubuga mu laboretori e Norway gye baasulamu sserumu, ekika kya musaayi omulongoofu, ne bapima obungi bwa selenium, kɔpa ne zinki.

Abakyala nga kati abakumi n’omunaana mu emitwalo gumu (181) abaali mu kunoonyereza kuno, abasinga obungi (ekitundu kyabwe) baalwala okuzaala mu kiseera ekitali kya bulijjo, era abanoonyereza baazuula obungi obw’amaanyi bw’ekika kya selenium, copper ne zinc.

Oluvannyuma ne baddamu okukola ku kubala kwabwe okutegeera ebintu ebirala bingi gamba nga myaka, obulamu obw’enjawulo, n’ebyo ebyali bibatuuseeko mu bufuzi bw’olubuto okusobola okumanya enkyukakyuka ez’obuwuka obutono obwabadde buvunaanibwa okuzaala abaana abakyali abato.

Baakuteekawo nti obuwuka obw’omuwendo omungi bw’ekika kya selenium ne copper tebwalina kye kyeyongera mu kuleeta okuzaala mangu, naye obuwuka obw’omuwendo omungi bw’ekika kya zinc bwakwongezawo omusango gw’okuzaala mangu emirundi egisukka mu mukaaga.
Kyokka, obungi bw’ekikomo bwali buli mbeera ey’okutya eri abanoonyereza olw’obulamu obw’obuwuka obutegeerekeka.

Okuva nga baali abakyala 181 bokka abenyigidde mu kunoonyereza kuno, kyaleetera abanoonyereza obutafuna bulungi ensobi ez’obulabe eziva mu mitendera gya selenium egiwera, kubanga omuwendo gw’abantu abakwatagana ogutuukirawo gwe 600.
Emibiri gy’abantu abenyigiddemu tegyanoonyerezebwa okunoonya ebiweebwayo ebiyinza okuba eby’obuwunga bw’emibiri, era n’obuwufu bw’omubiri (BMI) tebwawandiikibwa.
Kino kwe kunoonyereza okusooka okw’omuwendo guno okugema ebyava mu selenium, copper ne zinc mu bakyala ab’olubuto mu Malawi.

Afrika erimu emitindo gya nnambalala ez’okuzza abaana nga tebannaweza myezi gyabwe egy’omubiri - okuyitira ku 18% okwolekagana n’amawanga g’ebuvanjuba agali ku 5%, kyeyava abanoonyereza baagala okumanya oba emmere erina omulimu.
Empisa y’okudda eka, okukuuma ekifo kimu, n’okwewangaala kw’enjoka eya Pancake (Malacochersus tornieri) mu Kenya.
Ebisolo byoleka engeri za buli emu ez’enjawulo ez’ekifo n’ebiseera eziyamba okukuuma obulamu bwabyo.
Okutegeera engeri z’empisa ezo kye kintu ekikulu mu kulonda n’okulabirira obulungi obutonde bw’obutonde, naddala ebika ebiri mu kabi.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, twagezaako okulaba oba enjoka ya Pancake erina obusobozi bw’okudda awaka bw’eggyibwawo n’okunoonyereza ku kwegendereza ekifo n’obuwangwa bw’omuwendo gw’ekika ekyo mu maka gaabyo e Kitui County, Kenya.

Enneeyisa ya nkaaga 39 ezaali zibeera mu bulibi 12 ebyawukanibwa mu kifo, yazuulirwa okuva mu July 2020 okutuuka mu June 2022 nga tuyitira mu kukozesa radio-tracking, camera trapping, n’okuvangulula okukola obusembayo bw’ebibiina n’okukola obusembayo nga bwetaagisa.

Enkoko z’ennyonyi kkumi nnya zaasibwako ebintu ebyoleka awali, ne zitwalibwa okuva mu byato byazo eby’awaka ne zitwalibwa mu byato ebirala ebitali byazo, era ne bikolebwa ku byakola byazo n’empisa yaazo.

Okuva ku bakazi babiri bokka abaasobola okwefuga bulungi mu bulibi obw'omugaso obw'okusasula, ensolo endala zonna zaagezaako okudda mu maka gaazo, nga 46.15% ku zo zaasobodde okudda mu bulibi bwazo obwa bulijjo nga zikozesa obugendereze, ate 15.38% nazo ne zituuka mu bifo ebirowoozebwa okuba mu kitundu kyazo eky'awaka.
Okudda mu kifo kyabwe mu buwanguzi kulaga bulungi nti ensolo eno ebeerera mu kifo kimu.

Okunoonyereza ku bungi bw’enjoka ezibala mu buli bulimba bwalaga nti tewali njawulo ya muwendo mu bungi bw’enjoka ezaaliwo mu bulimba mu kusooka n’omuwendo gwa bulijjo ogwaliwo mu nnaku 162 ez’okugezaako (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P >0.05), era kino kyongera okukakasa nti enjoka eno emanyidde nnyo awali.

Ku luuyi olulala, okuwandiisa ebifaananyi n’okukola okunoonyereza okw’enjawulo (ad libitum sampling) byakiraga nti enkoko z’ekika kya Pancake zikwata ettaka, nga basajja balwanyisa ennyo abasajja abalala abayingira mu bitundu byabwe.
Enkoko za pancake ezibuzeeko ziri n’obusobozi obw’amaanyi obw’okudda awaka.

Abanoonyereza baafunye ekintu ekyewuunyisa nga banoonyereza ku ndabika y’enjoka ez’omu buvanjuba bwa Afrika (Malacochersus tornieri): ensolo zino zisobola okudda eka oluvannyuma lw’okusaasanyizibwa ebbanga ewaluse.
Okutegeera engeri gye bakola bwe batyo n’ensonga lwaki bakikola kiba kikulu nnyo mu kuwummula ebisolo bino eby’ekitalo.
Engeri y’okunoonya awaka enkoko zino gye zikola ekiyitibwa “okudda awaka”, era n’ensolo endala nnyingi zisobola okukikola.
Okusobola okudda mu bifo ebimu kiyamba ensolo okudda ku mmere, ku bannaabwe, ne ku kifo ky’okuwummula, ekyo ne kyongera omukisa gw’okubalamuwa n’okufuna abaana.

Wadde ng’okudda mu maka gaabwe kwatandikibwa okunoonyerezaako mu bikoko by’ennyanja n’ebya mu mazzi, abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno bagamba nti tukimanyi kitono nnyo ku kudda mu maka gaabwe kw’ebikoko eby’oku nsi (ebifaananako ebikoko by’ennyanja).
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baali baagala okutegeera ebisingawo ku bikolwa by’enjoka ez’ekika kya pancake mu maka gaazo emirimu mu bitundu eby’amabala eby’e Kenya.
Baakola okunoonyereza ku nsolo nga zigenda nga ziriira, era ne bwe zaagendanga okuwummula mu bulimba oba mu busembayo bw’olubalama.
Abanoonyereza baakolera okutuukiriza emirimu gyabwe ku bibinja by’ensolo eza pancake tortoises okumala ebbanga lya myaka ebiri, era ne bassawo kamera okuwandiika vidiyo y’ensolo zino nga tebalabira.
Baasikira ne bakozesa ebikozesebwa okuwandiika amasimu ku bikoko 14.
Gano ge bikola ebitono ebiyamba abanoonyereza okugoberera eby'ensolo, n'okukiraba awagendera emisana n'ekiro.
Awo abanoonyereza ne batwala ebirimba ebimu ebyo ebyali bikwatibwa mu kifo ekiggya, balyoke babikoleko obulombolombo obulungi.
Kyokka, ekyewuunyisa abanoonyereza, enkoko bbiri zaatandika okudda mu bitundu byazo eby’edda, wakati w’ekikumi n’ekikumi n’ekitundu (1-2.5 km) okuva we zaasukkirizibwa.
Lino lwe bannyonnyozi baasalawo okugerageranya okusonga ensolo ezingi okuva mu maka gaazo, okulaba obanga zandiraga empisa y’okudda eka.

Ekyewuunyo, obukadde obuli kumpi wakati w’enkulabe za nsigo zaasobola okudda mu buli mwe baali babeera nga tebanakyusibwa, emirundi mingi nga baagenda olugendo oluwera emikumi gya kilomita 1.5 okutuuka eyo.
Abalala 15% baasobola okudda mu kitundu ekyo, naye ne batasobola kuzuula olulimi lwe baali baggyiddwaamu.
Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti obuwuka obw’enjawulo businga okuba n’obungi bw’enjoka ezisulamu obusembayo, ekyo ne kiraga nti enjoka zikolera mu bifo bimu okuwummula.
Okuva ku vidiyo eya kamera, kyalaabikako nti enkoko ennume zaalina ettaka lyazo, ekitegeeza nti zaalwanyisanga ennume endala ezaali zeeyongera okuyingira ettaka lyazo oba olulimi.

Abanoonyereza bagamba nti lino lye lumu lwa kusooka okulaba embeera y’okudda mu maka gaayo mu bikoko bya pancake, era nti ebyo bye baazuuliza biraga nti ensolo zino zikulaba nga kirungi okubeera n’okwesiima mu bifo bimu buli lwe zisobola.
Okunoonyereza kwabwe tekwakakasa nti enjagu zino zezibalabika nga zidda awaka, n’olwekyo okunoonyereza okulondoola kwoleka okutegeera ensonga eno eya muwendo.
Olw’okuba ensolo oluusi zibeera ziwetaagibwa okusengulwa mu bifo ebibi, amagezi gano gajja kuyamba abakuuma ensolo okugolola enkoko z’amaaso mu maka gaazo agakya.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa nga mulimu gwa bakugu okuva mu Kenya ne China, era kyongera ku bumanyirivu bwaffe ku ngeri ensolo ez’ekika kya kinyonyi n’ensolo endala gye zifumbiranga.

Eddwaliro ly’omusaayi (Plasma Pharmacokinetics) lya Rifampicin ey’omuwendo omwangu oguweebwayo mu kamwa ne ogw’omu mituba egy’omusaayi mu balwadde abalina obulwadde bw’amakonde oluva ku kikwekweto kya TB:
Okunoonyereza okw’akawuka olw’omukisa (Randomized Controlled Trial)

Okuwanga obujjanjabi bwa rifampicin obungi okuyitira mu mitogo gisobola okwongera ku bulungi bw’obujanjabi bw’obulwadde bw’obuwuka obw’amaanyi mu bwongo (tuberculous meningitis), naye tekisoboka mu bifo ebirwaddemu abantu bangi.

Twategeeza nti obungi bwa rifampicin mu musaayi bwandyebeeranga bumu wakati w’okuwanga eddagala mu kamwa 35 mg/kg ya buzito bw’omubiri ne okuwanga eddagala mu mitogo 20 mg/kg, ekintu ekitegeerezebwa okukozesebwa mu kugezaako obujjanjabi bw’obulwadde bwa meningitis ebiva mu kawuka aka tubercolosis.

Twakola okunoonyereza okw’eddagala okw’ebika eby’enjawulo nga buli kika kiriko abantu bawo, nga kunoonyereza kuno kuwedde mu kunoonyereza okw’amaanyi ku bujjanjabi bw’obulwadde bwa meningitis obuva mu kawuka aka TB.
Abantu abalina akawuka ka HIV abalina ekikumba ky’obwongo eky’olukalala lwa tuberculosisi baasangibwa mu malwaliro g’e South Africa era ne bassibwa mu bibiina bya rifampicin eby’enjawulo:
Ennyongo eza bulijjo (okuwanga mu kamwa 10 mg/kg), ennyongo ennyingi (okuwanga mu kamwa 35 mg/kg), ne ku mutwe gw’omutaka (20 mg/kg).
Okusonda okw’amaanyi okw’eddagala mu mubiri kwakolebwa ku lunaku olw’okusatu.
Ebibala byawandiikibwa nga bikozeseebwa enkola eteri ya kibiina, era ebiwejjeyo byagerageranyizibwa nga bikozeseebwa enkyusakyusa y’omugero ogw’ekigero (GMRs).

Abantu 46 baagendeddwa okwekebejjebwa okusobola okulaba engeri omubiri gye gukolamu eddagala (omuwendo ogwa bulijjo, n = 17; omuwendo omungi ogw’okuwanga mu kamwa, n = 15; okuwanga mu mitogo, n = 14).
Omuwendo gwa CD4 ogw’akawaguli gwali 130 cells/mm3 (obusookerera bw’akawaguli [IQR], 66 okutuuka ku 253 cells/mm3).

Ebibalo bya rifampicin geometric mean area under the concentration-time curve okuva ku 0 okutuuka ku 24 h (AUC0–24) byali 42.9mg · h/ml (95% confidence interval [CI], 24.5 okutuuka ku 75.0mg ·h/ml) eri omuwendo ogwa bulijjo, 295.2mg · h/ml (95% CI, 189.9 okutuuka ku 458.8mg · h/ml) eri omuwendo omungi ogw’okuwanga mu kamwa, ne 206.5mg · h/ml (95% CI, 154.6 okutuuka ku 275.8mg · h/ml) eri omuwendo ogw’okuwanga mu mitogo.

Ennyinika ya rifampicin AUC0–24 GMR yali 1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 okutuuka ku 2.21) era omugaso gw’eddagala mu musaayi (Cmax) GMR yali 0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 okutuuka ku 1.23) ku bujjanjabi obw’okuwa eddagala mu kamwa mu bunene obusingawo okukwatagana n’okuwanga eddagala mu mitogo.

Obungi bw’eddagala lya rifampicin mu musaayi (AUC0–24) bwali bwa waggulu oluvannyuma lw’okunywa eddagala erya 35-mg/kg okusinga okufuna eddagala nga liweebwayo mu mitogo gya 20-mg/kg mu nnaku ezisooka ez’okuwangaza obulwadde bwa kasusu (TB).
Ebyazuulibwa bikwata ku kuwa eddagala erya rifampicin mu kamwa mu gezaamu ez’omu maaso ku siriika y’obwongo.
Ennyongo z’obuwuka obw’amaanyi zisobola okugezesebwa ku balwadde ba siriimu abalina obulwadde bw’obwongo obw’olubeerera.
Abanoonyereza bakakasizza nti kyetaagisa okutandika okugezesa oba obuwunga obw’omugaso obw’eddagala erya rifampicin buyinza okuwonya abalwadde ba siriimu abalina obulwadde bw’obuwongo bw’ekikujjo.
Abantu abalwala ekirwadde kya HIV abakola ekitundu kya 3 ku buli 5 era nga balina ekirwadde kya tüberikulosis meningitis, bafa olw’ekirwadde kino ekikwata ku bwongo.
Abalwala abawona balemererwa bulijjo olw’okwonooneka okw’olubeerera mu mutwe n’amawuggwa ag’enjawulo agava mu bwongo.
Kino kiyinza okukwata ku mbeera zaabwe ez’omutima n’okutambula kwabwe.
Abantu abamu bafuna obulwadde bw’okuwulira, oba obuwuka obw’omu mubiri, oba ebitundu by’amaaso oba omubiri gwabwe ne bifuna obulumbaganyi.
Rifampisin, eddagala ery’amaanyi ery’okulwanyisa akawuka akalwaza obuwuka obw’ekikumba, eteekebwa mu mpeke okusobola okutta akawuka akalwaza obuwuka obw’ekikumba mu bwongo.
Abalwadde abalwadde nnyo emirundi mingi basanga nga ennyongo zikaluubirira okumira.
Rifampisin era esobola okuweebwayo mu mitogo (mu mitogo gy’omusaayi) nga muzikirivu.
Oluvannyuma, olugoye lwegattibwa mu mubiri gw’omulwadde mu mugongo gw’omusaayi, olwo eby’okunywa ne biyitikibwa mu mubiri.
Okunoonyereza tekunnakoleddwa ku ngeri omubiri gw’omulwadde gye gukolera ku ddagala lino nga mukola mu ngeri eno.
Obujjanjabi obw’okuyunga omuti mu mubiri gw’omuntu buyagala ebintu bingi, okubeera mu ddwaaliro, ne omuntu obuyiiya omuntu omulwadde abadde nga amanyi okuyingiza akakondo mu mubiri mu bugolokofu.
N’olwekyo, si kya kutegeerezeka nti kiba kyetaagisa mu bitundu by’ensi ebitalina bintu bimala.
Abasawo bamanyi bulungi nti eddagala erya rifampicin telikwata bulungi mu mubiri gwa bwongo, omuguwa n’omutwe, gye bakitaawa bakwatibwa.
Eyo ye nsonga lwaki wetaaga obungi obw’omukwano (obuwuniki) okusobola okutta baakiteriya bonna mu mubiri gw’omulwadde.
Naye abanoonyereza tebaali bakakasa nti obungi ki obw’eddagala obwandyabadde obulungi era nga tebwetaagisa.

Abanoonyereza okuva e South Africa ne United Kingdom baagala okumanya, nga bakozesa abalwadde batono, oba nga kya butebenkevu okuwa edosi ey’omuwendo gwa rifampicin oba nga kapusule oba nga eyingizibwa mu mutono, n’engeri emitima gyabwe gye gigenda okugitwala buli kimu.

Kikulu okumanya kino nga abanoonyereza abalala tebannaba kutandika kugezaako okw’omugendera omukulu, oba okugezaako, mwe balina enteekateeka y’okuwa abalwadde bangi ennyo omuwendo omungi gw’eddagala lya rifampicin.
Omu ku ngeri ssatu ez’okujjanjaba rifampicin yagabibwa abalwadde ba HIV ab’e Afrika ebukiika kkono 46 abalina obulwadde bw’amavunike mu bwongo.
Ekyasooka kyali bujjanjabi obwa bulijjo obw’eddagala eribikibwa mu mpya, nga buli muntu afuna 10mg za rifampicin ku buli kilogramu y’omubiri gwe.
Olukiiko olulala lwaweebwa obujjanjabi obw’obuwungaanyi obw’amagulu 35 mu buli kilogramu ya buzito bw’omulwadde.
Ekibinja ekirala eky’okusatu baafuna obujjanjabi obw’okuyongeza mu mitomero 20 za miligiramu buli kilo y’omuntu.
Amasavu gaawerebwa mu balwadde oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ssatu.
Awo abanoonyereza ne bapima obungi bw’eddagala lya rifampicin obwali mu mazzi g’omusaayi gwabwe (ekitundu ekisikiriza mu musaayi).
Rifampisin yasanidde okusinga mu mibiri gy’abalwadde abaafuna obujjanjabi obw’obuwungaanyi okusinga abo abaafuna obujjanjabi mu mitogo oba obuwungaanyi obwa bulijjo.
Amatendekebwa ag’eddagala mu sseŋŋeŋe y’omusaayi gaali galinga ku mutindo omukulu n’okuweebwayo okw’okuyingiza mu mitogo.
Obungi buno bwali bwa waggulu okusinga bwe baawanga abalwadde omugaso gwa bulijjo.

Okusinziira ku bannoonyereza, kino kiraga nti embeera y’obulamu bw’abalwadde abalwadde ekikumba ky’obugonvu bw’obwongo (tuberculosis meningitis) esobola okutereezebwa singa bafuna edosi ey’omuwendo gwa rifampicin.

Tekikulu nti bafuna omusaayi ogw’omugaso, oba nga bagufunye mu bugoye oba nga bagufunye mu mitogo - ekikulu kwe kuba nti bafuna omusaayi ogw’omugaso ogw’omuwendo omwangu, kubanga omubiri gwabwe gujja kusobola okuwummulamu omugaso ogw’omuwendo omwangu.
Ebyavudde mu kunoonyereza bikwata ku ebyazuulibwa mu geesiga ezaakolebwa mu Uganda ne mu Indonesia.

Okusinzira ku geezamu ntonotono ebbiri ezaakolebwa mu Indonesia, ebyawandiikibwa byoleka nti obulamu bw’abalwadde bangi buyinza okuwonyezebwa singa bawa edosi eya waggulu ya rifampicin, oba nga bagiwagula oba nga bagiyita mu mitogo.
Kyokka, eky’ennaku, abanoonyereza balabula nti abantu abawagiddwa mu kunoonyereza kuno baali batono okusinga bwe baali balongoosezza, ekyo kiyinza okwonoona ebyavaamu.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa ebuvanjuba bwa Afrika.
Ekyo kiwagira olukusa lw’okukola okugezesa okwekenneenya oba kiba kya mugaso okuwa abalwadde ba siriimu abalina akawuka akalwanyi ak’obuwongoofu (TB meningitis) obungi bw’eddagala erya rifampicin.
Kisuubirwa nti obujjanjabi obwo bujja kulokola obulamu bw’abantu bangi mu Afirika ne mu bitundu bilala eby’ensi eby’obuzibu bw’obulwadde bwa meningitis eya TB.
Okukozesa obutale n’omubisi w’ebimera awamu, okusobola okutereeza obugimu bw’ettaka eryonooneka olw’obukadde mu kibira eky’oku lubalama lw’ennyanja?
Okukendeera kw’obugimu bw’ettaka kye kizibu kinene mu kulima mu bitundu bya Afirika eby’obukiika obwa ddyo.
Enkyukakyuka ennungi eza biochar ne kompositi ku buvubuka bw’ettaka zirabwa abawandiisi bangi.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, essaala y’okukebera mu laboretori ey’ennaku 30 yakolebwa ng’okozesa sampolo za gram 120 buli emu ey’omusenyu gwa Haplic acrisol ogwayongerwako omusaayi gwa corn cob (cbio), omusaayi gwa rice husk (rbio), omusaayi gwa coconut husk (coco300 ne coco700) oba omusaayi gwa nnukuli z’enkoko (compost); ne omusaayi gwa rice husk ogwakolebwa awamu (rcocomp) oba omusaayi gwa corn cob ogwakolebwa awamu (cococomp) ku mitindo gya 1% w/w ey’okwongera: ettaka, okusinziira ku buli kimu.

Enkola endala ezikozeseddwa mu kunoonyereza kuno kwali kuwangaanya omukutu gw’omusota gw’ebinyonyi ne biochar eya corn cob oba eya rice husk (1% omukutu + 1% biochar: 1% ettaka w/w), okwekebejja engeri gye zikwata ku kufuluma kwa kaboni okuva mu ttaka, obuwufu bw’ettaka; kaboni y’obulamu obutono obw’omu ttaka; obusobozi bw’okukyuka kw’ebitundu eby’ekika kya cation; kaboni yonna ey’omubiri, nayitrojeni yonna n’obuwufu bwa nayitrojeni.

Ebyokulwanyisa ebya biochar ne komposito, nga bikolebwa byokka oba awamu, era ne komposito eya biochar byongereza ekigero kya pH mu ttaka okuva ku 0.28–2.29 ebitundu bya pH, nga bigeraageranyizibwa n’ekitundu ekyalekebwawo nga tekikolebwako.

Okuwunda kwa buli kiseera okuva mu kibbo kya sose oba ekibbo kya mayi ekiyongoosebwa, oba ekibbo kya corn cob oba ekibbo ekiyongoosebwa n’ekibbo kya sose kyali kya waggulu okusinga ekya sampolo eteriiko kintu kyonna, ekyali kifaana n’ekya sampolo ez’ekibbo kyokka.
Mu buwumbi bw’omusenyu gwokka ne mu buwumbi obw’omusenyu gw’ekika kya corn cob ne omusenyu, obuwumbi bwali bwakweyongera okutuuka ku 37% ne 117% okusinga obw’omusenyu ogw’okugezesa.
Okukozesa awamu obuwuka obw’omubiri gwa rice husk ne komposito kyongedde MBC ku bitundu 132%, ate okukozesa komposito yokka kyongedde MBC ku bitundu 247%, nga bikwatiikiriza ku kigero eky’omutindo.

Mu kubuulirira, okunoonyereza kwalaga nti okukozesa omugongo gw’ebitooke oba omugongo gw’ebitooke n’ebikuta by’omuti awamu, oba omugongo gw’ebitooke nga gukolebwa, byongera obungi bw’ebintu eby’omugongo, gamba nga pH y’omugongo n’obungi bw’ebitundu bya bakiteriya mu mugongo, era bikolera ku kuteekawo kaboni mu mugongo okuyitira mu kwongera obungi bw’ekaboni mu mugongo n’okukendeeza ku kaboni ebuulikira mu mugongo olw’obusembayo bw’omugongo.
Eby'omubiri ne komposito byongera obungi bw'ettaka erirungi eri ebibala.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwakebera engeri biochar, ekintu ekibeerawo nnyo, ekirimu kaboni nnyingi, ekitondebwa okuva mu bitooke ebyasuuliddwa, gye kiyinza okukozesebwamu okutumbula obungi bw’ettaka mu bitundu bya Afirika ebiri wansi wa Sahara.
Okunoonyereza kulaze nti biochar ettamya obugimu bw’ettaka mu ngeri y’emu ng’enkola endala ez’ebbeeyi enkulu era ezitali mangu kuzibba.
Ekimu ku bizibu ebinene ebyoleka mu kulima mu bitundu bya Afirika eby’obukiikaddyo kwe kulumwa kw’obutonde bw’ettaka.
Obutonde obulungi bw’ettaka bwandisendasenda obungi bw’ebirime, ekyo ne kireetawo okukendeeza ku bwavu mu byalo n’okuddawo ku nsonga z’obutonde.
Okunoonyereza kulaze nti biochar, ekintu ekikakamaavu, ekirimu kaboni nnyingi, kiyinza okukozesebwa okutereeza obuwuka bw’ettaka.
Baiokaala kye kiweebwayo ekijja mu kuwumula ebintu eby’omubiri, oba omulamwa, mu mpewo muno mwe mulimu okusaana kwa okisijini kitono oba tewaliwo.
Kyazuulibwa nti biochar eyongera obungi bw’ettaka, eyongera amazzi n’omukka, era n’eyongera omulimu gw’obuwuka obutali bwa bulamu mu ttaka.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwagezesawo omulimu gwa biochar ne komposito ku mutindo gw’ettaka nga kozesa ebiragiro gamba nga okuwunya kw’ettaka, obuwufu bw’ettaka, obuwangaavu bw’obulamu obutono, obungi bw’ekika kya kaboni, n’obungi bw’ekika kya nayitrojeni obuliwo.

Abanoonyereza baakola obuwuka bwa cob ya kasooli, obuwuka bwa kookonati, n’obuwuka bwa lukusa lwa kalisa nga bakozesa enkola ya pyrolysis, eyaali eyingiza okukuma eby’omutindo mu buwuka nga tewali kisansa, ku 450 °C mu kikoomi ekyakolebwa mu kitundu.
Banoonyereza baakola biochar okuva mu lukalala lw’ekikolo ky’ekikajjo nga bakozesa enkola ya pyrolysis ku diguli 300 °C ne ku diguli 700 °C.
Awo abanoonyereza ne bassa ku bunyiriri obuwuggwe obwali buvuddemu obutonde bw’ebintu eby’omutaka okumala ennaku 30.

Buli sampoloyi yali erimu ettaka eryategekebwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo eryayitibwa Haplic acrisol, eryali ligasse n’ebitundu eby’enjawulo ebya biochar ebyakolebwa okuva mu bikondo by’ekikajjo, olukusi lw’omuyembe oba olukusi lw’omugavu, ne komposito y’obusa.
Ebyokugeza ebirala byalina oluvanyiso lw’ettaka n’emmere y’ebinyonyi, awamu ne rice husk biochar, ne corn cob biochar, okusinziira ku buli kimu.
Buli sampooli yali erimu 1% ya komposito, ne 1% ya buli biochar,  okuyamba abanoonyereza okwekenneenya omulimu gwa buli kivvulu ku mutindo gw’ettaka.

Abanoonyereza baazuula nti okugatta biochar ne kompositi mu ttaka, oba nga buli kimu kwekka oba nga bikwataganye, kyongereza muwendo gwa pH gwa ttaka okuva ku 0.28–2.29  yuniti za pH, bwe tugerageranya ne ttaka eritali mubikwamu.
Okweyongera kw’obuwuka (pH) kwoleka nti ettaka lyakendeera obuzikirivu.

Okunoonyereza kwalaga nti omuwendo omutono ogw’ekitundu kya kaboni ekivugumuka okuva mu ttaka (basal respiration), kyeyongera bwe wabongerwako omugongo gwokka, oba bwe gwakwatibwa ne kibira kya rice husk, oba kibira kya corn cob, oba kibira ebyakwatibwa wamu.

Ebyokugeza ku ttaka byalaga okweyongera kw’omuwendo gw’ekika ky’ekintu eky’omubiri mu ttaka (organic carbon) ogwa 37% bwe yakozesezebwa omugongo gwokka, era okweyongera okwa 117% bwe yakwatibwa wamu n’omugongo gwa corn cob.

Obungi bw’ebikolwa by’obulamu obutono bwayongezeka ku bitundu 132% mu ttaka eryali lya musonjo ne biochar eya rice husk, nga bwe kigeraagerannyizibwa n’okuyongera kwa bitundu 247% mu sampolo z’ettaka eryali lya musonjo wokka.
Ebyavudde mu kunoonyereza kuno biraga nti kisoboka okukendeeza obuwuka bw’ettaka nga okozesa biochar, ekintu ekisoboka okufuna mu buwanguzi era nga kigula wala.
Kino ky’enjawulo ku ngeri endala ey’okufukiriza ettaka, eya’okukozesa kalisiyamu, eya’ebbeeyi n’etaliwo ku balimi abato mu bukiika bwa Afrika ebuvanjuba.
Obutambi bw’ensimbi ez’enjawulo ez’akawuka mu kabenje ka Rheumatoid Arthritis n’enkola yaakwo ku bulwadde obw’okwekalakaasa, obuziba n’okukakkana kw’omusaayi.
Obuzibu bw’okufuna obulwadde bw’omutima mu balwadde ba RA bweyongera nnyo olw’okutuuka kw’obutonde bw’omubiri.
Enkyukakyuka eya citrullination eteekebwawo olw’obuwuka obulwanyisa omubiri ku bw'ekika bwa fibrin(ogen) n'obuwuka obw'okukola obutambi mu musaayi tekinnyonnyonnyebwa.

Nga bwe kiri, twagerageranya obuwunyiiki bw’omulimu gw’ebitundu by’omusaayi, obuwuka, okukakkana kw’omusaayi n’engeri y’okukakkana kw’omusaayi mu balwadde ba RA n’abantu abalamu obulungi, era ne tukozesa enkola ey’okwekenneenya enkolagana wakati w’ebintu ebyo.
Amasavu g’omusaayi gaakungubidde okuva mu balwadde ba RA 30 ne bannamawanga 25 abalungi abalina myaka n’obusembayo obutali bwa njawulo.
Amapimiro g’omuwendo gwa SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 ne VCAM-1 gaapimibwa nga mukozesebwa enkola ya sandwich immunoassay.
Okukakkana kw’omusaayi ogw’omubiri gwonna kwapimibwa nga tuyitira mu Thromboelastography.
Enkwaso ya fibrin ne bisiba byayo byakebezebwa nga mukozesebwa mikroskopu emiraba ebintu ebitono nnyo (Scanning Electron Microscopy).

Okukizuula n’okumanya obungi bw’ekintu ekya citrullination mu bitundu bya fibrin ebyali bifuuse nga bya buliimu byakolebwa nga tuyita mu kukozesa antibodi ya Citrulline eyalagibwa ekintu ekiruma omusana (fluorescently labeled Citrulline monoclonal antibody) awamu n’omukutu ogw’ekika kya Confocal Microscopy.
Amatendekezo ga SAA, CRP ne ICAM-1 gaali ga waggulu mu balwadde ba RA okusinga mu abo abatalina bulwadde.

Ebibalo bya TEG eby'okutandika okukakkana (R ne K), obuwanguzi bw'okukakkana kwa fibrin (α-Angle), ne kiseera eky'okutuuka ku buwanguzi bw'okukakkana okusingira ddala (TMRTG) bya wansi mu balwadde ba RA.
Ebibalo ebikwata ku buvuvu bw’omuguwa (MA, MRTG, TGG) tebyalaga njawulo ya balimu mu kwegayiriza mu bantu abalina ekirwadde kya RA n’abo abatalina.

Okunoonyereza okukozesa enkola ya logistic regression kwalaga nti ebiweebwayo eby’akawuka akawuka (CRP, SAA) bikwatagana nnyo n’ebipimo bya TEG okusinga ebibonerezo eby’obukwata bw’ebitundu eby’omu mubiri eby’omuwendo.

Okunoonyereza okukozesa mikulooskoopi kwalaga obutambi obuwuggwe obw’ensuŋŋo za fibrin ezikaluŋŋamye mu balwadde ba RA okusinga abalala [omugendera (ekitundu eky’enjawulo) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm okusinziira ku bwebalamu, p<0.0001, Odds ratio=22.7].
Okukizuula ebice bingi eby’enkyukakyuka eya citrullination mu bitundu bya fibrin clot mu balwadde ba RA, ekyo nga tekyali kya bunene mu sampolo z’abantu abatalina bulwadde (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Abalwadde abalina obulwadde bwa RA obw’akawungeezi balaga ebirimu mu musaayi ebitali bifaana n’ebyo ebiboneka mu bulwadde obulala obw’obutonde bw’omubiri.

Okukyusa obutonde bw’amaprotiini olw’okukola kwa mubiri okwekalakaasa okw’ekika kya citrullination, kiyinza okuba n’ekigendererwa mu kutegeka obutonde bwa fibrin ne busobozi bw’okuleeta obungi bw’omusaayi ogw’ekisosoze mu balwadde ba RA.
Okukakkana kw’omusaayi mu balwadde ba akawuka ka bavirimu kuyinza okunnyonnyola lwaki balina omutindo omwangu gwa kufuna obuzibu bw’omutima oba okulwala okw’amaanyi.
Okunoonyereza okupya ku muwendo gw’amaanyi mu mubiri (rheumatoid arthritis) kuwadde okutegeera okusingawo okulongooseza ku bikwata wamu wakati w’obulwadde buno n’obuzibu bw’omutima obweyongera.

Oluwadde lw’amaanyi ag’omubiri (Rheumatoid arthritis - RA) lwa bulumi era lufuula omuntu obutakola, nga lukwatagana n’obutonde bw’omubiri obw’okwekalakaasa (autoimmune) era ne kubuluka kw’amaanyi mu bituli ne mu mubiri gwonna.
Okuva edda, abayizi ba sayansi bamanyi nti abalwadde balina omugwira gwa 50% ogusingawo okufuna obulwadde bw’omutima (CVD) – nga okuwuluma kw’omutwe oba okufiira ku mutima.
Kintu ekikulu mu kabi ekyo kwe kuba nti obutonde bw’omubiri bulina omulimu mu nkola y’okusindika omusaayi.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baakebera enkolagana eno, okumanya ddala lwaki ekirwadde kya RA kyongera obungi bw’obulamu obw’omutima.
Okwogera mu bujjuvu, abanoonyereza baakebera engeri obutonde n’enkyukakyuka ez’ekikula ku bupoteyini obw’enjawulo obukwata ku kuzimba omusaayi, ebiyitibwa fibrins.

Amapuloteni gano gabeera mu mbeera y’olukalala oluwanvu olukola obugoba obusinga obw’omubiri ogw’omusaayi, n’olwekyo enkyukakyuka yonna ku fibrins zennyini eyinza okuba n’obuvunaanyizibwa ku nkola yonna ey’okukola omusaayi.
Abanoonyereza baagerageranya ebyokunywa by’omusaayi gwa balwadde ba RA n’ebyokunywa by’abantu abalamu.

Mu buli kiro, abanoonyereza baali banoonya “ebibonerezo” mu musaayi ebiraga obutonde bw’omubiri, awamu n’enjawulo yonna etali ya bulijjo mu nkola ey’okusisibaganisa omusaayi eyaayinza okweyongera obungi bw’obulabe bw’ekintu ekya CVD.
Ebibbo byawetekezebwa ne byekenneddwaako mu mikroskopu, okwetegereza enkyukakyuka yonna ku kitundu kya puloteyini ya fibrin.
Abanoonyereza baalaba nti obugobe obuva mu balwadde ba RA bwabumbibwa mangu okusinga obw’abantu abalamu, era nti ebisiba byabwo byali bikalu okusinga obugobe obwa bulijjo.
Wabaawo n’enkyukakyuka mu byaamino acids ebisiba puloteyini za fibrin, ebyazitera okubuuza omujjuzo gw’omubiri, nga kino kyaleetawo okwonoona okusingawo.

Nnyonyereza abalala baalabye enkyukakyuka mu kitundu kya amino acid eky’ekika kya fibrin mu bbugwe bw’abalwadde ba RA (olukalala lw’amaanyi), naye lino lye lwe luba olubereberye abanoonyereza okulaba omuwendo gwaffe mu musaayi.

Bwe bigattibwa n’enkyukakyuka endala eziragiddwa mu musujja omugumu, ebyazuulibwa bino biyinza okuyamba abayizi ba sayansi okutegeera obulungi enkolagana wakati wa RA ne CVD, n’engeri y’okukizuula obulwadde buno mu budde.
Wadde ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno bisanyusa, kyetaagisa okulowooza nti omuwendo gw’abantu abaakozeseddwa mu kunoonyereza kuno gwali muto.

Abanoonyereza era baategeeza nti enkola gye baakozesa okukizuula enkyukakyuka z’amino acid mu pulaaniini zino yandisobodde n’okuzza ebibala okuva ku bintu ebitaliiko mukago, ekitegeeza nti okwekebejja okw’enjawulo okweteekateeka ku fibrins kujja kuba kyetaagibwa okukakasa ebibala mu biseera eby’omu maaso.

Mu kiseera ekikulu, okutegeera enkolagana enzibu wakati wa RA n’okweyongera kw’obuzibu bw’omutima (CVD) kiyinza okutereeza ebibala ebirungi eri abalwadde ba RA nga tukoma okutegeera era n’okujjanjaba obulwadde buno mu ngeri ey’omugaso.
Abanoonyereza okuva e South Africa, Denmark ne United Kingdom baali mu kunoonyereza kuno, okwategekeddwawo olukiiko lw’okunoonyereza ku by’obulamu e South Africa.
Ebibalo by’obudde obw’ennyanja eri abakozesa ennyanja eya ku lubalama – endowooza, okukozesebwa kwabyo n’okukwatibwa kwabyo.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwe tukola kati kugezaako okukola ku nkyukakyuka wakati w’ebintu by’obuwangwa n’abantu mu ngeri y’obutali bumalirivu mu kutwala n’okufuna amawulire, ekyo kye tuyita obutali bumalirivu mu kukolera ku mawulire.
Mu mbeera eno, tukoowoola obukulu bw’amawulire g’obubonero bw’obudde mu nyanja (metocean) nga bwe gatuukirira abakozesa mu mawanga abiri ag’omu kibira eky’obukiikakkono:
Afirika wakati ne New Zealand.
Wano, ekigendererwa si ku ndowooza, okukozesa n’okutwalibwa kw’ebitanga by’ebizibu eby’amaanyi wabula kiri ku kutumbula okukozesa ebitanga ebya bulijjo.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa nga tuyita mu kubuuzabuuzabantu, nga kakolebwa okwekenneenya ebibuuzo by’okunoonyereza bisatu.

Ebibuuzo by’okunoonyereza byakwata ebintu eby’enjawulo okuva ku ngeri ebyuma eby’okubanza eby’okukozesa, obuzima n’obutegefu bwabyo, okukozesebwa kwabyo obulungi, enkolererwa y’ebitongole, n’obutali bumanyirivu obukwata ku nkyukakyuka y’obutonde (okwogera ku bimu ku byo).
Ebibuuzo eby’oku mutwe gw’olukalala byasaasaanyizibwa okukwata abakozesa ab’emizannyo n’ab’obusuubuzi bombi.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwali ku kutegeera enkola z’okulonda eziyinza okubaako omulimu gw’enjawulo ku byetaago by’amawulire by’abo abakozesa ennyanja ezirira ku lubalama.

Okunoonyereza okw’engeri y’okuŋŋaana kw’ebitekerezo (CCA) kwakozesebwa okwekenneenya okutegeera okugattiddwa n’enjawulo mu ndowooza mu kibiina kyonna ky’abo abaabuuziddwa, awamu n’ebibiina eby’enjawulo n’ebya mawanga.
Twalabye enkwatagana ez’enjawulo mu kibiina kyonna (abantu okuva mu mawanga gonna n’ebitundu byonna nga bikuŋŋaanye) nga bigeraagerannyizibwa n’ebibiina eby’abakozesa ab’enjawulo.

Abantu bonna abaali mu kunoonyereza, bwe batwalibwa wamu, baalaga okukkirizigana okw’omuwendo ogutuse mu buwanguzi ku nsonga ezaategekebwa, naye nga waliwo enjawulo mu ndowooza ku mitendera gy’ensi, ekyo ne kiraga nti waliwo obuwangwa obutono obutali bumu.
Bwe twakola okunoonyereza ku bitundu bya ggwanga n’ebitundu by’emirimu, twalaba okukkirizigana okw’amaanyi mu bantu abaakozesa mu South Africa, nga bakkirizigana nnyo ka babe ba mulimu ki.
Abakozesa mu byobusuubuzi ebya New Zealand be baali abalina okukkirizigana okunafu okusinga ebika byonna ebirala.
Tukubuulira ku bintu ebiva mu byetuzudde ku bintu ebikulu ebikwata ku kwesomesa omulimu era n’okuvaayo kw’ebintu eby’omukwano.
Ebintu bingi ebikulu ebijjumbirwa mu kwesulamu eby’obujjukizo obwa sayansi mu biseera ebijja, era bikuŋŋaanyizibwa nga tutegeera eby’enjawulo eby’obukyayi bw’obudde.
Tutuukiriza nga tuwaayo oluyimba lw’ekiteekateeka okwoleka enkolagana ey’omukwano wakati w’okukola wamu ku bintu ebyoleka eby’omu maaso n’obujulizi/obutegefu bw’ensimbi.
Abantu ba South Africa n’aba New Zealand bakkiriza ebiragiro by’obudde ku nyanja.
Abantu ba South Africa ne New Zealand abakolera era abeera mu bitundu ebyetoolodde nnyanja beesiga enkola za kulaga embeera y’obudde ez’okukozesa obulungi, era eziwa obubonero obutuufu buli kiseera.
Ebikozesebwa bya gavumenti eby’okuteebereza embeera y’obudde n’ebitongole by’obusuubuzi ebitali bimu ku mutimbagano wa internet biwa obubonero ku ngeri embeera y’obudde gyeeba.
Baafuba okuba abagolokofu era abawanguzi nga bwe kisoboka.
Okukola obunabbi bwokubikawo, kyetaagisa omulimu nnyingi ogw’ensimbi n’okuteesa okw’ensimbi.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baasalawo okulaba engeri abantu mu South Africa ne New Zealand gye bakozesaamu obusembayo bw’obubonero bw’obudde – ensi zombi ziriko obuwanvu bw’ennyanja, naye abantu n’embeera z’oku nnyanja z’enjawulo nnyo.

Baagala okumanya ekigero abatuuze bano ab’oku lubalama gye bakozesa obutabaganya amawulire g’obutonde obuva mu gavumenti oba mu bintu eby’obusuubuzi, ensonga ze bakozeseramu era oba baabiraba nga bifa ku nsonga era nga bikakkasibwa.
Bino bya mu nsonga za mukulu nga bwe tuba tulowooza ku ngeri enkyukakyuka y’obudde ey’omu maaso gy’eyinza okukwata ku kubikkula obudde.
Ebibuuzo eby’oku mutwekwano byaddamu abantu 31 okuva e South Africa ne 126 okuva e New Zealand.

Bano baali bawebako abakozesa ebyamagero by’obudde mu mirimu gyabwe (ng’abalobi n’ebitongole ebinoonya abantu ne babawonya), n’abalala abenyigira mu mizannyo gya mu nnyanja n’ebintu eby’okwesanyusaamu gamba ng’okusomba amaza, okukuba ebyato, oba okuwummula mu mazzi.
Abanoonyereza baabuuza ku ngeri obuweereza bw’obubonero bw’obudde obulondebwa bwe buba bulungi okukozesa, n’engeri ebyobujulizi bye bwe byali by’amazima era nga bikwatagana.
Abazzeeko baawandiika ebintu ebyabafudde eby’omugaso era eby’omukwano, ne boogera oba ebyo byandikyukira olw’enkyukakyuka y’obudde.
Baali bateekwa okwogera era oba baakkiriza amawulire agaweebwa ebitongole byabwe eby’obukadde, n’engeri gye baawuliramu.
Abantu abasinga obungi ababeera ebuvanjuba bwa Afrika abaali mu kunoonyereza kuno baali abasubi, oba abantu abayambagana mu kunoonyereza n’okutaasa abantu oba mu mirimu gy’okunoonyereza.
Abantu abasinga obungi mu New Zealand abaawabula ebibuuzo baalaba eby’obujjukujju olw’okwagala okukoma, okukuba oluguudo oba okutambulira ku nnyanja.
Abantu abaali mu bitundu byombi baakkiriza amawulire ge baweebwa ebitongole byabwe eby’obujjukujju.
Baali baagala obuweereza obw’okubikkulirwa eby’omu maaso obutuufu, obutegeera, obwangu okukozesa era nga bulina ebintu ebiyinza okukolerwa okukwatagana n’ebyetaago byabwe.
Abantu abaakozesa omulimu guno okunoonya emirimu mu bulijjo baalaba nga obubonero bw’embeera y’ennyanja obw’oku nkombe tebuba butuufu.
Amawulire ag’ebitundu ebimu gaali mazima okusinga ag’ebitundu ebirala.
Abantu ba Afrika Ddaala baali bakozesa enkola za kutegeera embeera y’obudde emirundi mingi okusinga abantu ba New Zealand, era baalijjukira buli lunaku.
Ku bantu 9 ku buli 10 abaabuuziddwa, enkola ya bulungi nnyo ey’okuteebereza yali ya muwendo nnyo.
Abasinga baali baagala omulimu ogubalaga ebintu eby’ennaku ssatu okutuuka mu nnaku musanvu ezijja.
Abantu abaakola mu bulimi bw’ennyanja oba abaalina okuteekateeka ebintu okusinziira ku mbeera ez’obulamu eziyinza okubaawo baali baagala okutegeera ebintu eby’omu maaso n’ebya biseera.

Abasigikiriza abasinga baali bakkiriza nti olw’okweyongera kw’enkyukakyuka y’obutonde, obuweereza bw’okuteebereza bujja kuba bukozesa ebintu ebirala eby’omukutu ogw’ensi n’okukakasa obuteebereza obutuufu mu biseera eby’omu maaso.
Okunoonyereza okw’ekika kino kutono nnyo okwali koledwa mu mawanga agali mu kibira kya Ddwaniro.
Abanoonyereza balina essuubi nti baasobola okuyiga bingi okuva mu bantu abaabadde bababuuzizza ebibuuzo.
Obunafu obumu obusobola okubawo kwe kuba nti abantu abasinga obungi ababeera e New Zealand okusinga ab’e South Africa be baagenze mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Omulimu gwabwe gujja kuyamba abantu abakolera mu buweereza bw’okubikkula obw’obudde okukola ebyamaguzi ebirungi ebikulukuta ku byetaago by’abakiliya baabwe.
Bajja kusobola okukola enkyukakyuka n’okulongoosa okusinziira ku ngeri abakkiriya baabwe gye basanyukaamu n’ensonga lwaki bakikozesa.
Engeri ey’okwetaba mu kugema obulungi bw’emirimu egy’obulimi mu kukolagana n’obukyamu bw’obudde:
Omusango gwa Lushoto
Enteekateeka y’obulimi obutaliisa obugulumivu bw’obudde (CSA) eyongera okukwatibwa mu nsi yonna.
Kyokka, tekitangaza bulungi kye kigwanira okubikkibwa mu nkingo zaayo ssatu—okukola omulimu, okwegendereza n’okwewala.
N’olwekyo, obulimi obuterekeza ku bya bulijjo (CSA) bukwata mu bulimi obw’enjawulo/amateeka g’obulimi, nga kino kireeta obuzibu mu kussa mu maaso ebiruubirirwa bya CSA.
Okusooka, tewali mitindo gya lwatu era egy’okukoleraako, awamu n’enkola z’okumanya obulungi bw’ebintu eby’okulwanyisa enkalo y’obudde.
Okusingawo, amagezi gattono ge gajjudde ku ngeri enkola ez’enjawulo ezikakasibwa nga CSA gye zikwata ku bantu, naddala mu nsi ezikyali mu kuteekawo eby’enjawulo.

Wabula, okussa ekintu mu kibinja ky’ebintu eby’okukolako (CSA prioritisation) tekwetegereza endowooza z’abantu abalinaako obukulu mu nsonga eno okukakasa nti enkola z’okukolako ze zigwanira, ze zaakukolerwa, era nti abantu bajja okukkiriza okukozesa.
Wano, tulaga enkola empya ey’okwetaba okwekebejja obukugu bw’ebintu eby’obulimi ebisobozesa okwewala enkyukakyuka y’obutonde bw’ensi mu mirimo gy’abasuubuzi abato.
Kino kiraga eby’okulabirako (n’ebipimo) eby’okufaamu eby’obutebenkevu bw’emmere n’okwewola mu nkingo za CSA.
Era ekyo kiwagira okukola omulimu gw’okuteesa ku by’okupima ebintu, nga kino kiyamba okukola okukebera okw’okusooka n’okw’omu maaso ku bintu eby’obuwangwa obulongoofu obutaliisa obutonde.
Enkola eno yagezebwa mu balimi 72 abaakozesa enkola ez’enjawulo ez’okusisinkana ebyobulamu mu kyalo kya Lushoto ekitunula ku mbeera y’obutonde mu Tanzania.

Abalimi naddala baasiima enkola ezaayongera obugimu n’omutindo gw’ettaka, n’okuwonya amazzi okukulukuta ku ttaka, n’okuddamu okukola ettaka eryonooneka olw’obuvunaanyizibwa obulungi ku byakulimbwa n’okulima mu biseera ebitali bya buli mwaka.
Okusinga, omulimu gwa CSA waleetera okweyongera kw’ebisolo, emmere, okukozesa emmere n’emali.
Enkola eno ya buvunaanyizibwa esobola okukozesebwa mu bitundu eby’enjawulo n’enkola za bulimi ez’enjawulo era eyaloza okusooka ku bikolwa eby’okuyamba.
Naye tukulabula nti CSA esaanidde okutwalibwa nga kitundu ky’enkola y’okukola okukwata, okwekebejja n’okuyiga.
Enkola empya ez’okukola okukebera zikuyambako abayizi b’ensi n’abalimi okutegekera enkyukakyuka y’obudde.
Abayizi b’ensiike abakolera wamu n’abalimi mu Tanzania kati basobola okupima obulungi bw’enkola ez’obulimi ez’empya okusobola okukendeeza ku bintu ebikulu ebiva mu kukyuka kw’obudde.
Basuubira nti enkola yaabwe ejja kweyongera okuwa abalimi mu bitundu by’ensi ebirala obulamu obulungi n’obungi bw’ebikozesebwa.
“Ebyobulimi ebyesigama ku kyalo” kye kimu ku ebyo Omunaala gwa mawanga amagatte guzzaamu amaanyi okusobola okuyamba abalimi abato okwetegekera enkyukakyuka y’obudde.
Omulimi omugezi mu byafaayo by’obudde afuga enkyukakyuka z’obudde era asobola okwongera obukuumi bw’emmere ng’agumya obungi bw’ebimera bye.
Kino kye kibazo ekikulu nnyo eri abalimi ba Tanzania, kubanga eggwanga liri mu kwewala ebibala by’emmere eza mukulu olw’enkyukakyuka y’obudde.

Kyokka, abanoonyereza bagamba nti kizibu okupima obwanguzi bw’enkola ez’okulwanyisa enkyukakyuka y’obutonde bw’ensi, gamba ng’okutema embizzi, era abalimi bennyini tebeebazibwako buli kiseera oba enkola ziri mu kukola nga bwe zaali zitegekeddwa.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baali baagala kuteekateeka enkola ey’okupima obwanguwa bw’enkola ez’okulwanyisa enkyukakyuka y’obudde, nga beetegereza nnyo okutumbula obulamu obulungi n’okwewola.
Okutandika, baasoma ebyoonyereza ebirala eby’obulimi ne bakola olukalala lwa bitundu bibiri ebyali birimu ebintu 14, oba “ebikwata,” eby’omukwano mu kupima obulamu bw’emmere n’okwekenneenya.
Awo, nga bakolera mu disitulikiti ya Lushoto e Tanzania, abanoonyereza baakolagana n’abalimi b’omu kitundu ne bakugu mu by’obulimi okusalawo ku by’okulabirako ebikulu okuva mu buli lukalala.
Abasuubuzi baalaga nti okukola emmere kye kintu ekikulu ennyo ekigendererwa okukuuma obulamu bw’abantu.
Mu ngeri endala, enkola yonna eyongera obungi bw’ebikozesebwa mu nnimiro yaabwe yali esinga okuba ya muwendo.
Mu kiseera kino, ku nsonga y’okwekenneenya, abalimi baali baagala nnyo obuyambi obubayamba okuziyiza ettaka ly’ebintu byabwe, n’obubayamba okwongera okumanya kwabwe, obukugu, n’emali.
Oluvannyuma lw’okumanya obukulu bw’omuwendo gw’obujulizi buli bumu, abanoonyereza baasobola okubukozesa okwekebejja obwatuufu bw’engeri mukaaga ez’okujjanjabya mu Lushoto.
Mu buli kifo, baabuuza abalimi b’omu kitundu, nga bakozesa akabonero okuva ku 1-5, oba waliwo okweyongera kw’ekiranga kino okuva omulimu gwatandika.
Ekyo kyabawa omukisa okwetegereza okuyingirawo ki ekwaliko omuwendo omwangu gwa kukola ku byokulya n’okwekenneenya.
Baazzuula nti emirimu 3 ku 6 egyali ekozesebwa gye yali ekolako enkyukakyuka.
Ebyo byali ebyokulima eby’omwanyi, ebyetaaga amazzi matono, era nga biwa emmere ennungi ensolo ezirya.

Abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola yaabwe etera okwanguyisa okukakasa nti ebyokukola eby’omu maaso bijjukira ebyetaago by’abalimi ba Lushoto awamu n’ebigendererwa by’obulimi obutaliisa obugulumivu bw’ensi.

Bagattako nti okusalawo ku ngeri ennungi ez’okuyamba nabo kyeyongera ku kakisa akalimu okusobozesa abalimi okuteesa ab’omu kitundu kyabwe ebikolwa ebirungi, nga kino kiyamba okusasaanya ebirowoozo ebikwata ku kukola emirimu egy’obuwangwa obutaliiko kabi ku mbeera y’obutonde.

Mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, enkola eno esobola okukozesebwa mu bitundu ebirala, era esobola okuyamba okukakasa nti enkola ez’obuwangwa obulongooseza obw’obutonde bw’ensi ziteekateeka embeera z’omu kitundu n’okumanya kw’abalimi mu mbeera, okuyita mu kugoberera n’okwekebejja okubaawo.
Bwe tukola bwetyo, enteekateeka z’obulimi obutaliisaamu nnyo enkyaaliro zikwata bulungi era ne zikula, mu Tanzania ne mu nsi endala za Afrika.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa nga kwegatta wamu kwa bakugu okuva mu Kenya ne mu Netherlands.
Endwadde ezibulula ensolo ez’emigongo egy’amawanga: Ebyo ebyazuulibwa mu South Africa.
Okwekenneenya eby’obulamu ebivaako obulwadde nga ebintu eby’ebweru ebyaliko eby’obuwuka tebikakasiddwa nnyo mu kusoma okukwata ku buwuka obw’ebweru.

Endwadde ez’ebbulamu ezaayingizibwa ziyinza okuba n’obuvunaanyizibwa obw’amaanyi ku bulamu bw’ebitonde, ku nzirukanya z’obutonde bye bituulamu, ne ku by’amaanyi by’ensimbi eby’enzirukanya z’obutonde ezo bye bizimba.

Mu nnyonnyesonnyo eno, tulikozesa ebyokulabirako by’endwadde ezaleteddwa mu nsolo ez’awaka n’ez’omu nsiko (ekikwekweto ky’embwa, obuwuka obw’ente, n’endwadde ya rinderpest) n’abantu (ebiwuka bya siriimu, ekikwekweto n’akaawuka ka HIV) okwoleka engeri endwadde ezo z’esobola okubaako.

Okuviirako okwasinga okw’amaanyi okutuukirira kati kwali kwa rinderpest, ekyaleetera okufa kw’ente obukadde, era nga kyazikiriza bulungi ensolo ez’enjawulo mu bitundu bingi eby’obukiika obwa ddyo bwa Afirika.
Kino kyaviirirako okutaaganya okw’amaanyi mu by’obwetegereza by’ekitundu ekyo, era kyaleetera enkyukakyuka ennene mu nteekateeka n’engeri eby’obutonde by’omwanya gye bikoleramu.
Obulwadde bwa rinderpest bumaze okumala mu nsi yonna, naye obulwadde bwa rabies eri embwa n’obwa bovine tuberculosis bikyaliwo, era kyetaagisa okwegendereza n’okubikolako okubikuuma.
Mu ndwadde z’abantu, ebiseera ebikulu bya sirimu bibadde byaweddewo okutuuka mu nsi yonna, naye omulimu gw’endwadde eno, eyaweebwayo abakoloni b’omu Bulaaya, gwali mubi nnyo.

Mu ntandikwa y’emyaka gya 1700, abantu ba Khoekhoe ab’omu butaka abasinga obungi (okutuuka ku 90% mu bibiina ebimu) baafa, ne bamenyaamenya obulamu bwabwe n’obuwangwa bwabwe, era abaasigalawo batono ne baddamu okukozesebwa ng’abaweereza ku birime.

Akawuka ka HIV, akasangibwa okusooka e Afrika ebukiika kkono mu 1982, kalinawo n’obuzibu obusingawo era obujjanjabi bw’eddagala eriwakanya akawuka ka HIV (ARV) bwokka bulimba gavumenti obuwumbi 66.4 bwa ZAR buli mwaka.
Tulina n’okwongerako akawuka ka West Nile ne akawuka akalwisa enkoko z’embizzi nga ebyokulabirako eby’endwadde ezaavanga mu Afrika, era eziyinza okwonoona ensi yonna mu biseera ebijja.
Tutegereza nti endwadde empya zijja kuwonekera nga abantu beeyongera okutuukirira mu bitundu eby’obutonde, era nga obuwanguzi bw’obusuubuzi bweyongera.
Ebyo abayizi ba sayansi bye bamanyi ku bikwekweto ebitono ebireeta endwadde mu South Africa

Olutundu luno lw’ekitabo lunnyonnyola ebintu ebikulu ebijjumbiddwawo ku ndwadde gamba nga rinderpest, ekikumba, omusujja, ne HIV, zonna ziteekebwawo ebisolo ebitono eby’obutabaze (obulwadde, bakiteriya n’ebitonde ebirala ebitono ebiweebwa erinnya ery’ebitonde ebitali bya wano, kitegeeza nti tebisangibwa mu kifo ekimu mu butuufu).
Obulwadde buno bwonna bukwata ensolo n’abantu mu South Africa, era okujjawo kwabwo kuba kuŋŋaanya ebyenfuna by’eggwanga.

Mu kifo ky’okunoonyereza ekiyitibwa ‘okunoonyereza ku bika by’ebitonde eby’obutabanguko’, abanoonyereza banoonyereza ku bitonde ebiba bulungi era ne bibaako obulabe oluvannyuma lw’okubiteeka mu bifo ebipya ebitabeera ebyabwe.

Okunoonyereza okusinga okukolebwa kwesigamye ku “bika by’ebitonde eby’obugagga” ebinene gamba nga ebibirimba n’ensolo, naye abalabe abato abalabika mu mikroskopu abaleeta endwadde nabo balina obukulu obw’enjawulo.
Mu nsolo eno, abawandiisi baayogera ku ndwadde ezimu ez’ensolo n’ez’abantu eziri mu South Africa, eziviirwa mu bika by’obuwuka ebyayingizibwayo.
Baagamba nti ekirwadde ekikyamu ennyo kwe ky’amagana (rinderpest), ekyazuuliddwa ebuvanjuba bwa Afrika mu mwaka gwa 1896.
Obulwadde bwa Rinderpest bwali buva mu kabuguma era bwakwata ente n’ennyama.
Akawuka kamu ke kaaleetera abantu akawuka k’akasusu.
Abantu bangi ab’oku nsiko baalumizibwa enjala oluvannyuma lw’okubuka kw’ekirwadde mu 1896, naye kaakano kirwadde kiweddewo olw’okutema okutaasa.
Bawandiisi bagamba nti wakati wa 1772 ne 1861, embwa nyingi ezaali mu Afrika eya Ddaala zaalina obulwadde bw’ekinyonyi, wadde nga abantu tebaali bamanyi bulwadde buno.
We 1893, kyali kimanyise nti obulwadde bwa rabies buva mu kabuga, olwo gavumenti n’esazaamu okutta embwa ezaali zikwatibwa n’okuwa enteekateeka ez’okuziyiza embwa ezaali tezikwatibwa.
Kyokka, kino tekyawonyaawo bulwadde bwo, era kyagenda kweyongera okukwata ensolo ez’omu nsiko nga duikers, empologoma, embwa ez’omu nsiko,  empologoma ento, n’emisota.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti mu 1928, abaana babiri baakwatibwa oluyombo olwa Yellow Mongoose ne bafa olw’ekirwadde kya rabies.
Okuva olwo, obulwadde bw’ekinyonyi bwakaddiwa mu South Africa.
Baagamba nti mu 1954, Abasuwazi bangi nabo baakwatibwa akawuka ka mumps.
Bwe kyawandiikibwanga essuulu lino, akawuka k’akabukasu kaali katta abaana nga 400 buli lunaku.
Baategeeza nti akawuka ka siririka kaali kasinga mu bifo abantu n’ente mwe baali bali kumpi.
Abalunzi era baayogera ku bulwadde bwa kaabukola mu nte (BTB), obuvubuka olw’obuwuka.
Obulwadde bwa BTB bwakwata ente, ennyama, ensolo ez’obusobozi, empologoma, ensolo ez’ekika kya leopard, ensolo ez’ekika kya kudu, ensolo ez’ekika kya baboon n’empologoma.
Baagamba nti obulwadde bwa BTB bwakakasibwa okusooka mu kibanja ky’ensika eya South Africa mu 1996.
Gavumenti yagenze etta endiga ezaalwadde okusobola okufuga obulwadde.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti akawuka akalala, akaayingizibwa mu South Africa ababenzi abava mu Bulaaya, kavaamu obulwadde obw’ekyeya ‘smallpox’ mu bantu.
Obulwadde bwatta abantu abasukka mu 90% ab’ekika kya Khoekhoe ekyaawaka.
Mu kiseera eky’enkomerero y’ekirwadde, omuntu gw’abantu ba Khoekhoe nga gwakomekkerezebwa.
Abawandiisi era baategeeza ku kabuyonjo k’obuwuka obulwanyisa obuweerwa bw’omuntu (HIV) obwavuddaamu obulwadde bwa siriimu.
Abasayansi bakyalirowooza nti akawuka kaasooka okuva ku nsolo ne kajja ku bantu, mu nkola ekiyitibwa zoonosis.
Akawuka kano kaazuuliddwa edda mu South Africa mu 1982.
Baagamba nti, okuva mu 2019, siriimu teyali na ddagala lyakawuka oba eddagala ery’okuwonya.
Baakomekkereza essomo nga boogeza ku kawuka ka West Nile ne aka African Swine Fever, nga bagamba nti kaava mu Afrika ne kaseera mu Bulaaya ne Amerika.
Akawuka ka West Nile kaasambibwawo enjazi era kaatatta ennyonyi nnyingi, naye ne kaatuusaako n’embalaasi n’abantu.
Baategeeza nti ensolo ng’empologoma n’embizzi z’omu nsiko ze zaasasaanya obulwadde bw’akadime ka ng’ombe.
Obulwadde bwakoma embizzi, era bwanyiga nnyo emirimu gy’okulunda embizzi.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti baayogera ku malwadde ga bakiteriya ne bayirasi byokka, n’olwekyo essuulu lino si lye liraga bulungi buli kibira ekisobola okubaawo mu mubiri.
Abawandiisi baali abava ebuvanjuba bwa Afrika.
Endagiriro ey'okujjanjaba ekikulukuto kya Odontogenic keratocyst esigamiziddwa ku bujulizi.
Okufuga obulwadde bw’amenyo obw’ekika kya odontogenic keratocyst (OKC)  bukyabeera kintu ekikulu era ekikyamuvaako okutabukana mu bitabo by’obujjanjabi bw’amenyo n’ebitundu by’omu kamwa.
Mu kiseera kino, tewali kigendererwa kya buli muntu ku ngeri esingayo obulungi ey’okujjanjaba abalwadde abalina ekizibu kya odontogenic keratocyst.

Mu ngeri za bujjanjabi ez’enjawulo eziriwo, tewali ngeri yonna ekyalaga obuwanguzi bw’okubaawo ate okuddawo kw’ekizibu okutaliiko oba okutono nnyo okuggyako okuyisamu ekizibu okw’enjawulo n’emisigiti emyangu.

Olw’obutabeerawo kwa bukakafu bwa nsonga z’okuweerereza abalwadde abalina ekizibu kya odontogenic keratocyst mu bitabo, okunoonyereza kuno kugezaako okulaga enkola y’okuweerereza abalwadde, esinziira ku byavudde mu kunoonyereza okw’enjawulo, era nga kigendererwa okuyamba mu kuweebwa obulwadde obulungi abalwadde abalina ekizibu kino.

Ng’okozesa ebipimo bya; obuwaggulu, ekika ky’ekikulukuto (ekikulu oba ekikwata), obubonero oba obutaba na bubonero bw’ekikulukuto, okubawo kw’obutundu obw’amaanyi mu buwaati, n’obuwaggulu obw’ebitundu; tulaga omugatte gw’okusalawo, okuyamba mu kulonzeereza emirimu gy’okuwonaza era okuyamba okufuna omukisa omutono ow’okuddamu okufuna obulwadde mu kuwonaza ekikulukuto kya odontogenic keratocyst.
Banoonyereza batendereza engeri ennungi ez’okuwonawo obulwadde bw’ekikono.

Mu kukozesa awamu ebyavudde mu kunoonyereza okw’emabega, abanoonyereza baategeka entambi ezigambika abasawo bayinza okukolera okutonda ne kuwangaza abalwadde abalina obulwadde bw’ekibumba ekiyitibwa ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
OKC ye kibala oba ekikula ekitali kya bulijjo ku mandibule g’omuntu.
Abasawo basanga embeera eno kizibu okujjanjaba, era abalwadde batera okufuna okulwala okulala okwa OKC ne bwe baba baawonyezebwa.
Abasawo bwe batyo bafuba okunoonya engeri ez’okukolamu obulungi era n’okuwonyera obuwuka obwo obwonoona ebiso by’ekikomo.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonye eby’enjawulo abasawo bye balina okukola okusobola okuzuula n’okuwona obulwadde.
Baakikola nga banoonya mu bitabo ebyaliwo, oba mu bitundu by’okunoonyereza okw’ebyenjigiriza, eby’OKC.
Baali baagala okumanya ennyo engeri abasawo gye baakolamu omulimu gw’okuwangaza OKC mu bbanga ly’omwaka gumu, nga bwe kyali kibikiddwa mu bitundu 46 bye baazuula.
Abanoonyereza baazuula nti obulwadde bwa OKC bwavundaala nnyo mu basajja okusinga mu bakyala, era buyinza okukwata abantu okutuusa ku myaka 90, wadde nga bwavundaala nnyo wakati w’emyaka 20 ne 30.
Obulwadde bwaviirirako ennyo ekinywa ekikadde.
OKC etandikira munda mu ggwattwa, nga kuŋŋaana kw’ebunwa ly’akakono kulabika oluvannyuma.
Abalwadde baasanga nga balumwa era nga balina ebintu ebifulumira (amazzi, gamba nga omubisi, agava mu kibwa oba omuwendo), era enkombe z’amenyo gaabwe zayinza okugenda mu bifo ebitali bimu.
Baalaba nti abasawo baggyewo ekibikkwa kyonna n’amenyo agali okumpi.

Bw’oba ogyazudde, balina okukozesa eddagala eriyitibwa Carnoy’s solution, awamu ne nayitrojeni eyennyonnyofu (amazzi ag’amaanyi ag’obusujju agakozesebwa okuggyawo amalegezi agamenyese) ne fluorouracil (eyamanyikiddwa nga 5FU, eddagala ery’ekikolwa ekya kansala).
Oluvannyuma lw’obujjanjabi obwo, abanoonyereza baawa amagezi nti omulwadde asaanidde okwekebejjebwa buli kiseera okutuusa emyaka 25.
Baagamba nti obujjanjabi buno bwe businga obulungi ku bibala ebitono okusinga ebibala eby’omu mubisi (3 cm).
Ku bunafu obuzingiramu obusingawo sentimita 3, abanoonyereza baawa amagezi ag’okubiteekaako omwoyo.
Baagamba abasawo basaanidde okusooka okukendeeza ku bwanguzi mu kibumba ekyo n’okuggyawo amazzi, era n’okuggyawo ebitundu byonna eby’omubiri ebiri okumpi n’ekibumba.
Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, ennyama y’omugongo erina kukozesebwako eddagala lya Carnoy.
Baakubiriza nti abasawo basaanidde okwekebejja abalwadde bano buli myezi 2 okumala emyaka 2.
Singa omuntu omulwadde alina ebibala bingi, abasawo basobola n’okubisaanyaamu nga bakozesa ebyuma by’eddwaliro ebikulu.
Kyokka mu bujjuvu, okunoonyereza okwekebejje kwalaga nti mu mbeera nyingi, singa abasawo baggyawo ekiziyizo ne bassaako 5FU, abalwadde tebaanditandukirako OKC nate.
Kyokka baalabula nti obujulizi bw’enkola z’obujjanjabi ezo tebwalimu bukakafu buli kiseera, era baazuula ebitabo bya sayansi bitono ku nsonga eno.
